1.discuss: The same trick won't work on me twice!
reply: Hehe~ You're free to challenge me again whenever you like.
Eyes on the prize, Commander. Whatever that might be~

2.discuss: You're no ordinary poker player, I'll give you that much...

155.text: Humans make such curious things. Be it this \"cell-fee\" gadget or that airborne metal bird.

1.discuss: Mikasa says the same sorta stuff sometimes!
reply: Oh? Does she, now?
Yeah, especially about airplanes. She still marvels over them every now and then.
Perhaps then she and I would make good acquaintances.

2.discuss: It is a wonder to witness the changing times, and with it, new generations taking the place of the old.
reply: Ahah! Let us all get together and talk about it over some drinks! What do you say?
I do so wish to try your foreign spirits. Let us decide on a date in person.

1.discuss: You mean \"selfie\"? A cell-fee is a bail.
reply: That is how you spell it? Well, I would say I've taken quite the picturesque \"selfie.\"
Quite. Had you wings of your own, I would take you on a journey you would late forget.

2.discuss: Man. I wish I could fly through the air.

156.text: Woohoo! My fortune says I have a very lucky year ahead of me!

1.discuss: Congratulations, Kasumi!
reply: I envy you, Kasumi! If only Fusou and I didn't have such unfortunate pasts... We could've used some extra luck!
Hehe~ I would share mine if I could. At least that's all behind you now!

2.discuss: Is that supposed to be a big deal? I've gotten \"exceptional luck\" for as long as I can remember.
reply: Gee, I wonder if that's because you just have stupidly good luck
You guys get good fortunes? My average one reads something like \"disastrous misfortune\"...
Oh dear... Don't worry! Luck is relative, so every instance of bad luck will be offset eventually!

1.discuss: Time to go buy a lottery ticket!
reply: Maybe I should! The stars seem pretty much aligned for it!

157.text: What do you think? Could I pass as a genuine shrine maiden?

1.discuss: You certainly performed the shrine maiden dance just like one! I'm impressed.
reply: I'm good at imitating and copying, so it was easy! Besides, you were great at teaching it to me.

2.discuss: You're such a good dancer, Honoka... I wish I could move like you do...
reply: Practice makes perfect, Harutsuki! Want me to give you some tips?
Yes! Please do!

3.discuss: I'm so happy to have made friends with another potential shrine maiden!
reply: And I'm so happy to have had an opportunity to hang out and practice with you Sakura Empire girls!

1.discuss: Easily, Honoka.
reply: Hehehe, really? Aww, you're making me blush~
We did! Everyone I've met from the Sakura Empire has been so kind and friendly!

2.discuss: Sounds like you all had fun.

158.text: Wherever you end up, you can know one thing for sure: that the stars will be super pretty.

1.discuss: Ah, stargazing, are we? The beauty of the cosmos is truly something to marvel at.
reply: All those countless stars in an endless universe... Makes you feel tiny, doesn't it?
Wanna gaze together sometime? I'd love to learn all the constellations you have here!

2.discuss: Did you see any shooting stars?
reply: I sure did! Lady Luck must really like me! (*_*) ☆彡
Oh! I hope I'll get to see one someday...
Let's stargaze together! Lightning might not strike the same place twice, but maybe stars do!
I'd love to... You're so nice, Misaki!

1.discuss: Why not set a date for some group stargazing?
reply: Heck yeah! Stargazing Day, let's go!
There's a few things you need to know, but it's not much more demanding than, say, fishing!

2.discuss: Stargazing seems like it takes a lot of patience and skill.

159.text: Literally setting up the christmas tree with the girls, pretty good if I do say so myself

1.discuss: Wow! Nothing says \"Christmas\" like a huge Christmas tree! Nice job, everyone!
reply: Sorry, what? I'm planting the star while you're taking a selfie!
Okay that's a fair point. Christmas only comes once a year though, gotta make some memories you know?

2.discuss: and there's the obligatory marblehead selfie. I was WAITING for it.
reply: With me in the background about to lose my balance because SOMEONE isn't holding the ladder...
Omg I'm really sorry. If I take a slapping pic of you in your dress will that make up for it?
I'll pass. To be fair, you did the most work with the tree anyway. Just next time, hold the ladder, please...

3.discuss: You know what this tree is missing? Candy canes!
reply: You know what else it could use? Gingerbread cookies!
Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it's the rocket decorations that this tree needs!
Gonna be more decoration than tree by the time y'all done with it lol

1.discuss: Strong contender for Christmas tree of the year.
reply: Hey thanks. Everyone in the Eagle Union dorm worked their butts off on this thing, and it shows.

160.text: I was just wrapping presents when this little guy jumped into the box!

1.discuss: They can be a real handful sometimes... It didn't ruin your present, did it?
reply: Nope, luckily! Wonder what made it hop inside... Maybe it was pining for its time inside a cat box?
Whatever it is, it's not normal. You should have Akashi examine it.
Not happening now that it's skittered off! I'm sure the little guy is fine anyway.

2.discuss: Adorbs. Classic meowfie. How's your presents btw? Coming along gud?
reply: Yup, got done with wrapping just after I finished playing with officer meow-meow here!
You're not gifting someone a cat for Christmas, are you?
Hahahaha! If only! Everyone I know already has a meowfficer!

1.discuss: One might say you were wrapping... PURR-esents.
reply: Yeowch! Now that's an oof-inducing sucker PUNch!

161.text: Look what I found. A Christmas ham in its natural habitat!

1.discuss: WTF! I told you not to upload this! UGH!!
reply: Aww, but you were so into it! \"Ho-ho-ho! You'd best not be on Hammann's perverted idiot list, or you're getting a scolding for Christmas!\"
Enough already! Delete this or Santa really will put you on his naughty list!
Lmao! Sister, I was born on the naughty list – molded by it!

2.discuss: You're volunteering to be Santa this year? Aww, what a diligent girl you are~
reply: Just trying it on, that's all... Just wondering: how do I look? Not too bad I hope...
No, not at all. It fits you perfectly!
You really think so?? Oh thank goodness! Thanks!!

1.discuss: You look to be in the holiday mood too, Sims.
reply: Call me Santa's little prankster!
What kind of compliment is that?? It definitely doesn't make me happy! Nuh-uh!

2.discuss: That's the prettiest ham I've ever seen.

162.text: Dear santa: here are milk and cookies, now gib steak and drumsticks! Good night!

1.discuss: Did you seriously draw and put up a picture of a drumstick? Is meat all you ever think about?
reply: Father Christmas will surely get a laugh out of it! I certainly did!
I have a feeling like Yuudachi's wish will come true. Let's wait and see.

2.discuss: GUESS WHAT! Just found a nice fat drumstick in my stocking! Suck on that, non-santa believers!
reply: Santa Claus always rewards girls and boys who have been good throughout the year.
I'm gonna be a good dogger next year too if there'll be a reward waiting for me!!

1.discuss: Being good pays off.
reply: Indeed it does. What about you, Commander? Have you been good this year?

163.text: Oh what fun it is to ride on a one-hundred horse-power sleigh! ♪♬♪

1.discuss: Delivering presents in mad style!
reply: It's a shame to see the reindeer go, but this upgraded sleigh is stunning in its own right.
Dashing through the snow... I'd probably be laughing all the way too.
Reindeer just don't cut it anymore! If you wanna meet the present quota, you gotta go real fast!

2.discuss: Blazing across snow-topped banks under the moonlight... This gives me inspiration.
reply: It's a bumpy ride on this bad boy, but it can traverse just about anything! Perfect for my needs!
Sounds like my tinkering did the trick. Stellar.
Sure did! You've got a magic touch with these things.

1.discuss: Houston, we have liftoff...
reply: Briefly, just went over a bump. I'm 8-ish reindeer short of a sleigh that can actually fly.
The temperature is cold, but my outfit is hot, so it balances out.

2.discuss: Aren't you freezing, wearing just that?

164.text: Candy canes, lollipops, gingerbread! Christmas candy is the sweetest! (≧▽≦)

1.discuss: Don't forget Christmas cake, milk and cookies, and pecan pie! We're only scratching the surface of the candy iceberg!
reply: Oh boy, I'm starting to feel a sugar crash coming on...
Tell me about it... Someone else play the role of Saint Nicholas while I take a nap...

2.discuss: Remember: brush your teeth after eating candy, or the Plaqinator will send his cavity creeps after you!
reply: Eep! You're right... Wouldn't want my sweet tooth to develop into a rotten tooth!
Lamest supervillain ever...

1.discuss: Now you've got me craving sweets.
reply: Well... We're out of candy, but if you wanna eat something sweet, there's always me...

165.text: The kotatsu's warmth seeps into my being... and now, I don't want to get out.

1.discuss: First time? The kotatsu meme is not just a baseless anime trope~
reply: We must not fall for such temptations! Let us brave the cold outdoors – together!
If eating tangerines under the kotatsu is wrong, then I don't wanna be right~ Join the comf party, RJ~
My conviction is being tested... Will I persevere, or give in to sloth? To be continued...!

2.discuss: That's how it gets you~ Once you slide your legs in, you won't ever want to leave.
reply: It seems not just the heart desires warmth, but also the body...

3.discuss: The Queen of the North is dead! Long live the Queen of the Kotatsu!
reply: I will return to my frozen throne soon. Just... 5 more minutes...

1.discuss: The kotatsu claims yet another victim!
reply: Indeed... But you know its warmth too, do you not, Commander? I take solace in that fact.
Ah, yes, the tangerines were excellent. Thank you for bringing them, Commander.

2.discuss: Mmm, yummy tangerines.

166.text: Osechi will be available today at the cafeteria.

1.discuss: WHOA! I'll be there faster than you can say kamaboko!
reply: The Royal Maids, and Miss Hiei who gave us guidance, welcome you to partake in the feast.
All I did was offer a morsel of my experience. It is the Royal Maids who deserve all the praise.

2.discuss: And might I ask what \"osechi\" is?
reply: A beautifully-assembled collection of traditional Sakura Empire foods eaten around New Year's.
Well, why didn't you just say so in the first place! I think I will give it a try!

3.discuss: Exemplary work, Belfast! Show the world that no cuisine is too complex for our maids!
reply: You honour us, Your Majesty. We shall gladly prepare any dish you wish us to.

1.discuss: Hey, leave some for me too!
reply: But of course, Master. We have already set aside a helping just for you.

167.text: Has anyone yet to receive their New Year's gift?

1.discuss: Thanks for the gift, Amagi! Most of it will go to Pooky's food budget, but hey.
reply: Be sure to treat Pooky to the best pet food you can find.

2.discuss: Aren't these usually given to friends and family? Why'd I get one?
reply: Because you are like family to Akagi. That makes you like family to me.

1.discuss: Can I get one too?
reply: But of course, Commander. You need only come and claim it at your leisure.
Oh, one for little old me? You're too kind, Commander~

2.discuss: Guess what? I have one for you!

168.text: I got a New Year shark from a nice Sakura Empire lady. Raaaawr!

1.discuss: U-110 seemed to really like my shark-print envelope.
reply: it's so good! I'm gonna show it off to all my friends!

2.discuss: Aww, ain't that cute? Wish I'd gotten one with an albacore print
reply: It so happens I have a little surprise for you. Come see me when you have time.
Wait, for realsies?! Whoa... I'm not used to being on the receiving end of surprises!
you could set up a commission system and make bank off of this.

1.discuss: Are those great whites or tigers?
reply: they're shaaarks. guraaawr.
you do? is it something sharky, or a swirly-whirly?

2.discuss: I've also got a gift that'll make your jaws drop.

169.text: Pooky and I wish you a happy New Year!

1.discuss: Happy New Year, Suzutsuki! Soon spring will be upon us.
reply: Yup yup! It'll be warm again before long.

2.discuss: I hope the next year will be... well, better. Of course, I'd always say that, but after this one especially...
reply: The darkest hour is just before the dawn! Don't worry.

3.discuss: I'm still waiting for it to be year of the cat!
reply: good luck with that one lmao
I know there's no such thing, DUH! I'm just saying!

1.discuss: Pooky sure is one cute furball of joy.
reply: Hehe! I like to think I am, too! Minus the fur.

2.discuss: Happy New Year to you too!

1.discuss: What's so special about drawing water for the first time of the year?

Someone's cultured. Unlike Hipper, who spent New Year's Day sleeping in.
AND WHOSE FAULT IS THAT?! I was up all night, listening to your drunken rambling!

2.discuss: I love the smell of fresh coffee in the morning.

See ↑THIS↑, Eugen? And when *I* do it, it's wrong?!

reply: I dreamt I turned into an army of San Diegos and graced everyone with my smarts!
Kasumi saw dozens upon dozens of Foos in the dream world...
Your dreams... they all seem so interesting to this one...

Whoa, really?! That's a load off my back! Thank you, Shinano!

1.discuss: Happy (sleepy) New Year!
reply: Grateful is this one... May spring grace all of us shortly...

1.discuss: When there's a million things you wish for, it ain't easy deciding on just one
reply: That's why you needed more time? Geesh.
One plaque for one wish just ain't enough for the one and only Lebe, y'know
You are just greedy. I suggest simply wishing for world peace.

2.discuss: Only sheeple make wishes! The Fiend of the Crimson Darkness seizes what she desires with her own hands!
reply: So... you're a sheeple, then? You wrote down a wish too.
Indeed. I believe it went: \"I wish to never have to do homework again.\"
The both of you, that is so rude! Peeping toms! Spies!

1.discuss: I feel you, Lebe. It's not easy.
reply: It's tough, I tell you... Heard it's called \"decision fatigue\" when you get tired of trying to decide on one of many things

173.text: Bought this thing called an \"omamori\" while on a shrine visit.

1.discuss: You're gonna have to explain what that means.
reply: It's basically a Sakura Empire amulet! Some promise good luck, others ward off evil spirits. I bought one for you too.
Oh really? That's cool, thanks!

2.discuss: Got any for me~?
reply: Funny you ask, cause I do. I got you one that promises academic success.

3.discuss: Question is: do they even do anything?
reply: Kinda! The more you believe in them, the more you subconsciously work toward the thing you want ^^
So it's a self-fulfilling prophecy kind of deal? Interesting...
I've got some for you gals too! These promise fortune, in both meanings of the word.

1.discuss: Blue head to toe. You look great.
reply: Thanks! You're a real looker yourself, you know.

174.text: Whew. It's been a hectic, but fulfilling day!

1.discuss: Your hard work is greatly appreciated! Thank you for all your help.
reply: It was nuts... You serve one customer then two more queue up right after...
But hey, that's funding for the shrine's foreseeable future secured at least!

2.discuss: Great work, nya! The gods will be very pleased with our sales report, nya!
reply: As will your investors, I'm sure.

3.discuss: We would've been overwhelmed with visitors without Chiyoda's and Chitose's help!
reply: Just glad we could return the favor. You've helped us plenty before.
Akashi did compensate us too, so there's that... Hope it won't be so busy next time...

1.discuss: Hats off to you for going above and beyond.
reply: Thanks! We're always happy to help at the shrine.
I got this close to passing out... Way, way too many people...

175.text: Mmm! I don't know what \"shiruko\" or \"zouni\" actually are, but boy do they smell delish!

1.discuss: I can tell you one thing they have in common: they both have mochi in them!

my suggestion: have one of them now, then save the other for dinner. how's that?
Ooh, that's a good idea! Très bien!

2.discuss: I've heard of mochi. It's one of the Sakura Empire's confectionary staples, no?
reply: Your sweets sense is tingling, huh~? Will we see a Sakura Empire x Iris Libre cuisine crossover soon?
me, I'll just have the zouni as-is. I'm hungry.
Aha! I had a feeling you were more of a zouni person!

1.discuss: Next time, we could have one each.
reply: As good an idea as any, Commander! Just watch out for New Year's excess.
And heaps of it, too! You can add it to almost anything!

2.discuss: Can't have a Sakura Empire New Year without mochi.

176.text: Lucky Laugh is harder than one might think.

1.discuss: The sillier it looks, the better! That's the point of the game :)
reply: I will admit, I did crack a smile upon seeing my own creation.

2.discuss: meh, it's a good game and all but I know a better one: pin the tail on the akagi
reply: Oh, I know a better one yet: pin a dagger through the vermin's heart! Any volunteers~?
Let's try something a little less violent. Truth or dare might be your thing, Akagi.
Splendid idea! I will arrange a private truth or dare session with the Commander at once!

1.discuss: Heh. You got pretty close, though.
reply: As did you. I never took you for one with such good intuition.

177.text: Ugh... Feels like there's a maelstrom brewing in my stomach...

1.discuss: Are you all right, dear? I warned you about eating too much.
reply: Well, what's done is done. Can't blame her for gorging herself on Hiei's next-level cooking.
Exactly... You blink and suddenly you've wolfed down 3 whole servings...

2.discuss: Oh dear... I suggest eating some nanakusa-gayu to aid digestion. It is the season for it, after all.
reply: Thanks, Doc... I'll have some of that. This time, one serving only...

3.discuss: Yeah I'm kinda feelin it too...
reply: Have you ever tried not inhaling your food, dumb dog?

1.discuss: Gluttony might be a sin, but oh is this relatable.
reply: We're stomach pain buddies... Now let's both learn from our mistakes...
Ah, it's a type of rice porridge with 7 types of herbs, traditionally eaten around the 7th of January.

2.discuss: Nanakusa-gayu? Tell me more.

178.text: I've been told these balls are not suited for playing dodgeball. Is this true?

1.discuss: Well, no... Temari, as they're called, are probably not the best for playing dodgeball, or any ball game.
reply: You don't dribble or toss em around, you hold onto em for good luck! C'mon, you should know this!
I was today years old when I learned that temari truly are not suited for ball games.

2.discuss: Do I look like I give a damn? No! I'll play fetch solo if I have to!
reply: What next, you gonna move into a doghouse and bark at stray cats?
HAH! You might think you're so smart but I'm way ahead of you!

1.discuss: Just imagine how much effort goes into a temari.
reply: Maybe that is part of the reason why they shouldn't be thrown around.
You will? Superb! It would be great if you could join us for a match, Commander.

2.discuss: I'll put dodgeballs on the requisition list.

179.text: The Sakura Empire's got sweet drinks for New Year's. Bottoms up.

1.discuss: Do you mean \"sweet\" literally? Are you having amazake, by any chance?
reply: sounds like it! sure it's okay for her to drink that though?
It's got really low ABV so I wouldn't worry.

2.discuss: Really low ABV? Well, I don't mean to be a stereotype, but... Heresy!
reply: Call me a heretic then but this stuff is GOOD.
Just don't have too much of it, all right?

1.discuss: I'll drink to that.
reply: Way ahead of you, comrade Commander.
Uh-huh, but in drinkable form. That's more my style.

2.discuss: Sounds a bit like rice porridge.

180.text: Tossing dice puts me in the mood for some high-stakes cee-lo!

1.discuss: Can we just NOT gamble and play Momopoly like normal people?
reply: Oh cmon Suruga! Don't be so low-energy!

2.discuss: Cee-lo, you say? I have some time to kill. Why not.
reply: That's what I want to hear! Let's go babyyyy!
I didn't agree to this! You said we were going to play Momopoly!

3.discuss: Kii's the dealer? All right, I'm in! Been ages since our last game
reply: Would you PLEASE read the comments? Momopoly! NOT cee-lo!

1.discuss: A literal dice roll... I mean, sure.
reply: Feel like joining us, Commander? We'll wait for you.
Thank you, Commander. At least YOU'RE in favor of sticking to the agreed-upon plan!

2.discuss: Did someone say Momopoly? I'm game!

181.text: It's New Year's, you know what that means! Our annual game of Poetry against Humanity!

1.discuss: Always fun to play! The eye strain from looking at the same cards all day, not so much, though...
reply: I had excellent cards, and I still came last! How?! Am I cursed with bad card luck?
Even the best cards are no good if added to a verse where they don't fit, Akatsuki.

2.discuss: Poetry against Humanity? That's quite different from the card games I'm used to...
reply: Hanafuda, poker, and PaH ultimately boil down to one thing: it's all about how you play your cards!
A bit of an oversimplification... Though Souryuu is kind of better than me at card games across the board...

1.discuss: DesDiv 6, all together in one place!
reply: As we always said we would be! We are bound by an eternal connection!
Sense of direction, cause of genuflection.

2.discuss: Fill in: Akatsuki's ____ is her ____.

182.text: Actually, being kagami mochi is fine~

1.discuss: I've heard of Long Island iced tea, but Long Island mochi's a new one...
reply: Just don't eat me, I'm only a spooky-slash-festive decoration~
my brain says no, but my stomach says yes (º﹃º)

2.discuss: You shouldn't play with food. Or pretend to be food either.
reply: It's not the real thing, just a comfy cushion that looks like it~
Oh. Never mind, carry on then...
Where can I buy one for myself?

3.discuss: Reckon it's bout time someone told ya what we do with kagami mochi...
reply: There's more to it than putting it up just as a decoration?
Yeah well... See, come jan 11th they've turned hecking hard, so then we take a big ol hammer n crack em open.
NOOOOO I DON'T WANNA BE MOCHI ANYMORE!

1.discuss: Promise you won't destroy NY City with your puffiness.
reply: Don't worry, nobody would choose this as the form of their destructor~

183.text: Behold! Thor's hammer; the Mjölnir! I jest, of course. It is an ordinary hammer.

1.discuss: What's it for? Some Sakura Empire tradition? If so, where do I sign up?
reply: As Shouhou explained to me, it is part of their custom called \"kagamibiraki.\" It is for smashing mochi.
Why wouldn't a knife just cut it? No pun intended...

2.discuss: Now that's what I call a recipe for a smashing time! Can I bombard it too?
reply: I estimate a >75% probability that you're only joking, sister, but just in case: doing so would vaporize it.

3.discuss: Don't do iiit! What has the poor mochi ever done to you?
reply: I'm sorry, little one. The deed is already done.
No amount of Sanity potions will help Long Island recover from that one...

1.discuss: Mochi, what happened? Mochi?! MOCHIIIII!
reply: The mochi is inanimate, Commander. You are being silly.

reply: There is no need to worry. This is just sagichou – a paper burning festival, part of our New Year traditions.

Sorry about that. My body just locks up when I see fire...

2.discuss: \"Sagichou.\" It's got a nice ring to it.

185.text: We're working on decorations for the Lunar New Year!

1.discuss: You're splitting the workload, I presume? You need a lot of decorations for LNY.

186.text: It's time to start the cat ear revolution (*ΦωΦ*)

1.discuss: Ooh! Ooh! Do Belfast first!

1.discuss: As long as it's achieved by peaceful means!

187.text: Look! Aren't my new friends adorable?

3.discuss: Nice. I made a snow кролик.
reply: Wh-what does milk \"do\" to you? I just have a bottle or two after a bath...

1.discuss: A collar is, let's say, a \"novel\" item to put on a snowman...
reply: I've got normal-sized ones too! Interested in trying one out, Commander?

188.text: Just chilling and waiting for the gang to show up~

1.discuss: You hanging out with Astoria today?
reply: Plus a few others! By the way you checked out the latest edition of fashion d'azur yet?
Fashion d'Azur? Can't say I have. Usually I just consult you when I need fashion advice.

2.discuss: Didn't expect to spend the whole afternoon chatting about fashion. Let's do it again next time you're free!
reply: Ayy, time flies. I'm free whenever so just hit me up when you are
Astoria's into fashion too huh. Almost starting to feel like the odd one out here.
You're missin out bigtime Balti. Why not join us for the next meetup? It'll be fun!
Hm... I'll think about it.

1.discuss: They still sell that tea? Thought the hype around it died down.
reply: Kinda, but the drink survived! Some places are putting out new flavors too so they're making a small comeback
It's rated 4.7 stars for a reason! I'll DM you the address later so you can check it out

2.discuss: Where is this place in the photo? Looks comfy.

189.text: A refined lady fusses over the details, including, but not limited to, her nails.

1.discuss: Interesting... So that's what I need in order to blossom! I see, I see!
reply: There are many ways to ladydom, GB. This is just one. Would you like to know more?
In fact, yes, I would! Please be my guiding lady, Pola!

2.discuss: Pola's always been really good at painting nails, both her own and mine. Thanks for the nail art, by the way.
reply: You're welcome, sis. It's always a pleasure to work with your hands.

1.discuss: You could open a nail salon with your level of skill!
reply: Oh please, I'm only an enthusiast. And besides, my other skills have more relevancy at the moment~
It is. Nail art can get quite intricate and colorful. Would you like to give it a try, Commander~?

2.discuss: Nail art? Sounds like more than a single-color coating.

1.discuss: I was NOT expecting Above Average Joe to vanquish Thanatos with a punch to the face! Like, just a regular right hook!
reply: That's why his character is so good! He doesn't need OP powers, he wins using only his wits and unpredictability!
Yeah! And how he had to pick up his father's mantle, figuratively and literally, that really spoke to me.

2.discuss: Did they really have to keep the camera moving like, constantly? My head was spinning by the end of the film...
reply: Sorry, I'd forgotten the director is kind of infamous for that. I'll find a film with gentler camerawork for next time!
Could we vote on what film to watch instead? I know of a fascinating Saratoga documentary that Gridley made.
Isn't that a little niche? I say we find a film we can all enjoy!

3.discuss: I kinda spaced out near the film's start middle and end but the potato chips were good!
reply: That's fine too. Feel free to stop by again next time!

1.discuss: New life goal: vanquish a Siren by punching it.
reply: Hahaha! Maybe someday, Commander. Anyone can be a hero with the right mindset!
Right?! The scene where he comes back from the brink of death is pure kino!

2.discuss: Best movie I've seen in ages!

191.text: After hearing so much about this signature Dragon Empery dish, today, I finally tried hot pot.

1.discuss: It was an honor to get to prepare it for you, Miss Richelieu. How did you like it?
reply: It was excellent. Enlightening, even. It gave me a look into a whole other world of cuisine.

2.discuss: Though certainly appetizing, isn't mutton prepared in this manner highly unorthodox?
reply: What is unorthodox varies by culture. More than this I cannot say... other than that it is very spicy.
We'll have a great get-together soon, with lots of hot pot on the menu. You're free to join us and try it for yourself, Jeanne d'Arc!

1.discuss: You can tell it's spicy just from the pic alone!
reply: It truly is. You feel the heat not just on your tongue, but through your whole body! It is an intense experience.
It is quite warming, but take care not to overeat it. Your stomach will thank you later.

2.discuss: Hot pot sounds like a good remedy to winter chills.

1.discuss: Nothing soothes the soul quite like cuddling cute kitties does.
reply: my soul would've been more soothed if you hadn't forced me to come along. just saying.
You say that, but you sure seemed to be enjoying yourself, snuggling with those cats.
i didn't snuggle anything, they lied down next to me, that's all.

2.discuss: That cafe is heaven on earth! I wanna see that black kitty again!
reply: Let's visit it again then. How about next week?

1.discuss: Makes me wish I had a cat.
reply: Why not get one then? There's space in your office, isn't there? Hehehe~
I can vouch for the fact that they are. But don't take my word for it, why not go and see for yourself?

2.discuss: They might be even cuddlier than Meowfficers are.

193.text: Dumplings are an essential part of the #SpringFestival

1.discuss: We helped make them! And taste-tested a few too!
reply: I told you a million times, Ping... you're not supposed to eat raw, unstuffed dumplings.
But my stomach was growling like a Nian beast! Plus, they were yummy as-is!

2.discuss: I admire how you can mold dumplings into all kinds of different shapes, Yat Sen. All I can make are regular, boring ones...
reply: Don't beat yourself up over it. At least you do better than Chao Ho.
Hey, rude! I can do it if I just concentrate, okay?

3.discuss: Hehe, I wonder who'll be the lucky taster of my spicy surprisy ghost pepper dumplings!
reply: Your WHAT?! Chang Chun, get over here RIGHT NOW!

1.discuss: They're tricky to fold just the right way. Takes skill.
reply: Indeed they are, but you're quite good at it, Commander!
You said it! I'm so hungry I could eat a dumpling horse!

2.discuss: Dinner can't come fast enough! Need dumplings!

194.text: Sweet are these nuggets, gelatinous their skin. Their chewy casings cover the delectable contents within.

1.discuss: Aren't those tangyuan? That dessert they eat during holidays in the Dragon Empery?
reply: They seem almost... magical! I must have one!
I know but one truth–the sublime flavor of these forbidden fruits.

2.discuss: Isn't that tangyuan... glowing? And quite a lot, at that?
reply: I don't think food in general is supposed to glow!
Food serves one purpose: to satiate hunger. The light is my respect for the meal, manifested.

1.discuss: So, is this your glowing recommendation for tangyuan?
reply: Its savor must be experienced, not described. A taste shall enlighten you.

195.text: Did someone say FIRECRACKERS?! Watch out, port city, it's gonna be a loud night!

1.discuss: Once you crackle and pop, you can't stop!
reply: Aw yeah! And that barrel-size firecracker you set off at the end was amazing!
It was really pretty. But also tremendously loud... like thunder struck right next to us.
Hey, you can't make a firecracker omelet without almost cracking a few ear drums!

2.discuss: It's only a matter of time before you get hurt if you keep making these colossal firecrackers...
reply: I'm not dumb! I know how to dive for cover! And don't pretend like you don't enjoy watching it go off!
Look, it's called supervision! If I don't keep an eye on you, then who will?

1.discuss: Just good, clean, explosive fun!
reply: Yeah! Besides, we're trained in the use of naval cannons, so what harm can a few firecrackers do?
This! It's like popcorn without salt! You need a bit of (read: a lot of) bang-bang!

2.discuss: What's a festival without firecrackers, right?

1.discuss: Wow! Looks dangerous, but fun!
reply: Depends on the slope and your experience but yeah! Give it a go, Kent!

2.discuss: that's me on the left there. never found any new pets among the snow, but skiing was wunsy-funsy
reply: You were looking for pets on a snowy mountain? Are you even allowed to have pets? I have so many questions...

3.discuss: Aw yeah, that mountain's good for skiing. And snowmobiling! Shoulda seen me yesterday!
reply: First skateboarding, now snowmobiling? What sports AREN'T you good at, Minny?

1.discuss: Skiing is good and all, just be careful!
reply: It's perfectly safe, don't worry. This was just a beginner's course!
Always have! Not every day I get to use it on land though!

2.discuss: Putting that winter gear to good use, I see.

197.text: I'm knitting a sweater for Master, made with love...

1.discuss: Whereas I'm incapable of knitting even a scarf! Truly, I am a pitiable maid deserving of punishment!
reply: It's no big deal. I can't knit, heck, most people here can't.
I'm confident that the commander will recognise the effort that went into your craft, no matter what you make.

2.discuss: You have quite the knack for knitting, don't you, Dido?
reply: My ability still pales in comparison to yours...

3.discuss: Hah, Sirius looks like a wee cat playing with a baw of yarn.
reply: What a naughty kitty...

1.discuss: I feel warmer just looking at this picture.
reply: A direct reply from Master!! You're too kind to me! Thank you, thank you, thank you so much, Master!!!
Honourable Master! Now you've seen how woefully incompetent I am! Please, punish me however you see fit!

198.text: This is a public service announcement! Eat fruit! The fresher, the better!

1.discuss: I'm with you on that one. Fruit is good for your health and protects you from malnourishment and disease.
reply: Like scurvy! You don't wanna know what it does to you, just eat fruit rich in vitamin C!

2.discuss: What about fruit juice? Doesn't that work just as well? :3
reply: I suppose? It isn't precisely the same thing, but it's fine as long as it's freshly squeezed.

3.discuss: Pardon, but did you take these fruits from the kitchen, by any chance? It is to be served later tonight.
reply: I'm making a point here! Don't stress the details.

1.discuss: You could make a juicy fruit salad out of these.
reply: Sure. Whatever gets the fruit down your gullet at the end of the day.
It's true! Combine that with a balanced diet and you're set.

2.discuss: An apple a day keeps the doctor away, as they say.

199.text: Whew! A bottle of cold milk after a hot bath always hits the spot~

1.discuss: Milk, huh. Milk... I guess you really are what you eat -_-
reply: I'm... milk? I don't see what you mean...

2.discuss: Is THIS what milk does to you?! This is simply ridiculous! How long have you been drinking it for?!
reply: Wh-what does milk \"do\" to you? I just have a bottle or two after a bath...

3.discuss: I smell money to be made, nya! @Shiranui Place an order for 50 crates of milk, nya!
reply: Perhaps we should invest in dairy farm stocks as well... This could be a big market, green cat.

1.discuss: Milk is nice, and so is its source... Hummina hummina...
reply: Pardon? Huh... Would you like me to bring you some milk, Commander? It's good for your bones!

200.text: Aw yeah, this came out lookin nice!

1.discuss: Now that it's actually up on Juustagram it feels just like, kind of weird... a little childish idk.
reply: Don't say that. You look cute together.
Thanks! Wanna make it a group photo and pose with us, Mogami?
Thanks, but I'll pass. I'll ask Mikuma if she wants to go instead though.

2.discuss: Childish?? Yoooo what are you talking about you both look sooo cute! @Baltimore let's take a photo like this rn!
reply: What? Now?! I'd need time to prepare!

1.discuss: This pic has a certain ying-yang quality to it.
reply: Hey yeah I see what you mean! Almost makin me feel like a palette swap here lol
It's mainly just for the photo, although I do like having one every now and then.

2.discuss: I never knew Suzuya liked lollipops.

201.text: Lovely signorinas and exquisite food. My two biggest vices. They combo quite well, too!

1.discuss: The dinner party was splendid, Miss Littorio. Thank you so much for inviting us.
reply: No, signorina, thank YOU for coming. I always cherish our time together.

2.discuss: Sardegnian food never disappoints! And neither did our gracious host!
reply: I would've loved to indulge myself in all the delicacies on offer, but a lady must watch her calorie intake...
I'm glad to hear it. Your gratitude makes all my efforts worth it.

1.discuss: Wining and dining is a tried and tested strategy!
reply: Indeed, and I consider myself an expert at it. Wouldn't you agree, Commander?

202.text: The commander's chair is mine! You must all get into the ******* robot! (Don't take this seriously.)

1.discuss: Hey, that's definitely Comrade Commander's chair! But... where's Comrade Commander?
reply: No longer in office, that's where.
WHOA WHAT?!
Which is to say, out in the harbor. I just seized the opportunity to take an amusing photo.

2.discuss: I don't like where this is going...
reply: I Am (Not) A Four-Eyes.

3.discuss: This isn't a coup, is it? I'm allergic to power struggles.
reply: I think it's just Belorussiya having a little fun.

1.discuss: There's more to my job than just sitting in a chair.
reply: Perhaps, but it's a big part of it. You should get out more often. I'll keep your seat warm while you do.
And with great authority! Allow me to wield it, and I won't disappoint you!

2.discuss: Being the commander comes with great responsibility.

203.text: I like to treat myself and my comrades to a beer now and then.

1.discuss: Thanks for the drinks. That wasn't a half-bad evening at all.
reply: Then how about we do it again sometime? I'd love to chat some more about guitars and music.
Aww, look, Hipper's made a friend. Now just don't flip your lid and lose her.
I have PLENTY of friends and I NEVER flip my lid, thank you very much!

2.discuss: Thought the cliche was that Northern Parliament folks only drank vodka?
reply: Scharnhorst, please. That's only a stereotype. We don't drink only bier, do we?

3.discuss: Bier is too weak. I need something with more kick to it.
reply: Variety is the spice of life. You need weak drinks to contrast strong drinks with!

1.discuss: Who doesn't love a cold one after a day's work?
reply: You included, I hope. Try to make it for the next meet, would you?
Didn't notice it until after we took the photo. Although I'd rather have that than a beer belly!

2.discuss: Heh, a classic beer mustache.

204.text: Who's a good one-tailed girl? You are, yes you are~

1.discuss: ADORABLE! I wanna pat her too~
reply: She scuddled off back into the wild shortly after. I hope we'll meet again though~

2.discuss: The port's vicinity is home to surprisingly many critters. I wonder if we're allowed to have pets.
reply: If not, I can make do with just meeting a new cute critter each day~

You could each fluff one of my tails, if you'd like!

1.discuss: I, too, need some fluffing right now.
reply: Hehe, no surprise there! You're a fluffaholic through and through, aren't you, Commander~?
Yep! They'll gladly let you pat them if you just show that you're friendly.

2.discuss: You managed to tame a snow fox, just like that?

205.text: Check out what I made! Pretty good, right? ( • ̀ω•́ )✧

1.discuss: Is that your raccoon? That's pretty cool.
reply: Yup, yup! I'm really proud of how it turned out!
You should enter a snow sculpture competition. I bet you would take home first prize~

2.discuss: You like playing in the snow too? Oh boy! Let's make a snowman and have a snowball fight!
reply: Sounds good! Bring all your friends too!

3.discuss: New objective identified. Planning construction of snow sculpture.
reply: Ooh! What are you gonna make? A snow cathedral maybe?

1.discuss: All that's missing is the stripes, then it's perfect.
reply: I'd need soot or something for that! I don't wanna get my mittens dirty.
The tail was the trickiest part! Snowsculpting is a real art.

2.discuss: It even has the hat!

206.text: Pests lurk behind the bookshelf. They must be terminated.

1.discuss: What kind of pests are we talking here?
reply: The resilient kind whose name inspires fear and disgust... Cockroaches.
Mother of god... Yeah, it's time to terminate all right.
DU-DUN DUN-DUN-DUN! DU-DUN DUN-DUN-DUN!

2.discuss: Good thing we discovered them sooner rather than later! And that we had roach spray in the storage!
reply: Mm, that's all of them. The enroachment has been dealt with.

3.discuss: Pests, you say? I'm something of an expert on disposing of those, should you need help in the future.
reply: Um, I don't think we're on the same page here...

1.discuss: You didn't... destroy the bookshelf, right?
reply: No. Thanks to Gromky's bug spray, we didn't have to resort to that.
Just hope they won't return with a vengeance.

2.discuss: Hasta la vista, roaches.

207.text: The revolution must go on! If ice blocks our path, we shall march THROUGH it!

1.discuss: Well said, comrade! Mother nature's coldest obstacles are nothing to our fiery hot resolve!
reply: Yes! We are an unstoppable wave of steel!

2.discuss: Those are inspiring words to me as a leader... But I must ask: do you NP girls really sail through ice all the time?
reply: Don't be ridiculous, we're not icebreakers. We only do it sometimes.
A small embellishment for the sake of illustrating our fighting spirit, comrade. But it's not far from the truth.

3.discuss: interesting. what marvel of Northern Parliament engineering is this?
reply: Engineering has nothing to do with it. We smash through the ice with our sheer determination!

1.discuss: Just don't ram into the enemy, all right?
reply: If the enemy stands in our way, then they will meet the same fate as the ice!
None can match our unwavering resolve!

2.discuss: That's the fighting spirit I like to see!

208.text: POV: you are Captain da Recco's second mate, helping her plot a new course

1.discuss: SPIIIIIIIN! Captain, second mate-slash-sailor Libeccio wants to spin it too!
reply: It's all yours! Now get a pen and paper and start jotting down those lats and longs!
How on earth can you see anything when it's spinning so fast?
Two words: high-def eyesight! You kinda develop it over time as a navigator.

2.discuss: What do you say to becoming my own navigator, matey? There's lots of booty in it for you.
reply: This here girl loves to sail the sea, but I'm no pirate! I'm gonna have to kindly decline!

1.discuss: Don't tell me this is how you actually navigate...
reply: What if it is, and I'm just that good? :^)
Aye-aye, Admiral!

2.discuss: Set sail for uncharted waters!

209.text: All my photographs came out blurry, despite my best efforts... Could it be that my camera is broken?

1.discuss: No camera can accurately capture your beauty, signorina.
reply: A servicable pickup line, but a poor explanation, I'm afraid.
Whichever your interpretation, I meant it only as a joke.

2.discuss: What were you trying to photograph, Veneto?
reply: The beach, of course! Every moment at the beach deserves to be immortalized.

3.discuss: I might be able to help. When did you buy it? What model is it?
reply: In order: the other day, and I don't know. A green-haired cat in a hat and sunglasses sold it to me at a discount.

4.discuss: Tried using a tripod? Usually that helps. I can DM you some good ones if you want
reply: It does? By all means, I'd love your recommendations!

1.discuss: Try adjusting the focus. On the camera, and on the subject.
reply: Oh! That made a significant difference! Thank you, Commander!

210.text: A Sardegnian dignitary must always act with splendor, no matter the task at hand.

1.discuss: Uncorking a bottle with a rapier isn't \"splendor,\" that's just showing off! Ngl though I wanna learn how to do it!
reply: When you've grown, I will teach you. A rapier is too much for a \"fun-sized\" girl to handle.
Aww come on! How can I be old enough to serve in the navy but a rapier's outta my league?!

2.discuss: Sardegnian crimson nectar doth live up to its reputation, I must say.
reply: I am glad to hear it. Know that you're always welcome to our private banquets.

3.discuss: Such remarkable swordsmanship! We must spar together sometime, I implore you!
reply: Many a legend have I heard of Iris' swordfighters. I shall add a duel to my bucket list.

1.discuss: Where's the line between splendor and showiness?
reply: Sincerity. Vanity has a distinct smell, one which I steer very clear of.

211.text: Ah, what a lovely tea party this was! Thank you for joining me, my Iron Blood friend!

1.discuss: This frivolous little gathering proved more entertaining than I thought.
reply: You really loved my tea and sweets, didn't you? I'm glad! I went all-out with them.
They played no small part in my enjoyment. That much, I will admit.

2.discuss: For but this brief moment, Graf Zeppelin's visage was free of detest and displeasure.
reply: Gaiety is not in my nature, nor does it suit me. Don't aggrandize this photograph.
You sound like such good friends~ Z46, I'd love to have you at our next tea party!
A gracious offer. I thank you.

1.discuss: I suppose Graf doesn't hate tea parties, at least.
reply: You'd be surprised by how fun it is talking to her when she's in a good mood~

1.discuss: Growing out of a tin can?
reply: mhm... aren't they pretty? I need more containers so I can grow a whole colony of them... hehehe...

2.discuss: Are they edible? I could make a yummy sauté out of them if so!
reply: they're not poisonous at least... I could spare a few, I guess...
Not poisonous does not necessarily mean edible...

3.discuss: that corner looks cool and cozy. mind if I come join you?
reply: make yourself at home... the more, the merrier... hehehe...

1.discuss: Mushrooms can grow indoors? In a can, at that?
reply: shrooms are hardy little friends... they can survive and thrive almost anywhere... even your private quarters if given the chance... hehehe...

213.text: Always study for your tests, everyone. Make your teachers proud.

1.discuss: That's exactly what I want to hear! Gold star for you, Maestrale!
reply: A gold star? I thought that was just common sense? Well, thank you in any case!
I WISH it was! My job would be so much easier if all my pupils were half as diligent as you.

2.discuss: But studying is haaard! My brain is too smooth to comprehend trigonomewhatchamacallit!
reply: It really isn't... Should I help you with it? You picked up algebra quickly after I explained it to you.
Yes please! I'll take anything that helps me get a passing grade at least!

1.discuss: We have an up-and-coming ace student.
reply: I wouldn't say I'm an ace student, I just happen to be good at this subject... But thank you.
You and me both! If Maestrale can't help me understand this alien math, I'm toast!

2.discuss: I hope Libeccio won't flunk.

214.text: Hohoho! Nothing beats a cup of tea in the evening, isn't that right, my fellow ladies?

1.discuss: the teabag is still in the cup... isn't that frowned upon by hoity-toity types...?
reply: Not when it's black tea, which this fortunately is! Oh yes, everyone knows that!

2.discuss: Mmmm I'd love a cup of black tea right about now
reply: Who wouldn't? It tastes so delectable, so full, so... um, you know, wonderful!

3.discuss: Take care not to drink too much before bedtime. Black tea is high in caffeine.
reply: That would explain the buzz... I might be reaching caffeine saturation already.

1.discuss: It's not everyone's cup of tea, but it's good.
reply: Speaking of which, do you want some tea too, Commander? There's lots to go around!

215.text: Look, Mr. Bear! A giant robot exhibit!

1.discuss: Whoa! Are those tokusatsu mecha props?
reply: I dunno. All I know is they look awesome! I wish they'd let you touch them.
Tell you what, I could make a cosplay if I had more reference pics! Wanna take some together?
Oh! I'd love to.

2.discuss: mecha, hmm? interesting. we're officially abandoning ship development to work on giant robots.
reply: Wait, are you serious?!
no, it's called making a silly joke.

3.discuss: I've got spare figs of these guys~ I'm low on display space so whoever wants one, hmu~
reply: For free?! I do!

1.discuss: Ah! This hand of mine burns with an awesome power!
reply: Take this! My love, my anger, and all of my sorrow!
It doesn't matter how strong you are if you can't hit me! Muahaha!

2.discuss: Trying to touch the valuable props? I'll stop you!

216.text: We got together and... sang karaoke...

1.discuss: Best night out ever! We should totally do it again soon!
reply: I was nervous at first without my mask... but I had fun after getting in the mood...
Can't really sing with a mask on, y'know?
Maybe you can... if you're a shapeshifter at Poe's masquerade...

2.discuss: Why do you cover your face? You shouldn't be afraid to show your beautiful looks, Boise.

I haven't been practicing THAT much! just a little...

1.discuss: You stole the show with your brilliant singing, Boise.
reply: Thanks... You're really good at singing too, Commander...
Right, yeah! Like the fries, they were great...

2.discuss: The snacks were pretty good for a karaoke bar.

217.text: Hey kiddies! I'm Archerfish, your teacher for today! Let's dive into the world of marine biology!

1.discuss: I love field trips to the aquarium! Even if I don't understand anything, I always leave feeling smarter!
reply: Mhm, that's what's called intellectual stimulation~

2.discuss: So I've been thinking... We're submarines. Can't we just go in the tanks to have a closer look at the fish?
reply: huh... never thought about that before.
you think they'd let us?
No, fishbrains! No scales, no entry!

3.discuss: is that... a giant isopod plush?

1.discuss: Tell me some more about marine life.
reply: You want some hands-on solo tutoring? Sure can do, hottie! Hehehe~

1.discuss: I love this ride! Let's go on it again!
reply: Heck yeah! And after, we'll go on even splashier ride!

2.discuss: siiiick. should've told me you were going to the water park!
reply: I didn't think you'd be into it, U-37! We'll definitely invite you next time!

3.discuss: It felt like my heart was going to pop out of my chest... I don't really wanna ride it again...
reply: It's less scary if you sit in the front and have someone hugging you from behind!

1.discuss: Looks like all the fun of a roller coaster and a water slide both at once.
reply: Yup yup, it is! You should come with us and try it sometime, Commander!
Fortunately not, but I was very close to giving up the ghost...

2.discuss: Just hope I-25 didn't lose her lunch...

219.text: Strap in cause it's gonna be a WIIIIILD RIIIIIIIDE!!!

1.discuss: Wowie, I'm seeing stars! And I'm not just talking about myself!
reply: Them's the guiding stars named Thrill, Ecstasy, and Vertigo!

2.discuss: This looks even more exciting than the water coaster!
reply: A bit TOO exciting, probably...
Ain't no such thing as\"too exciting\"! Try it, you won't regret it!

3.discuss: Wild roller coasters are so on-brand for SF.
reply: Not so much for me... They make me queasy and dizzy.

1.discuss: That loop-the-loop looks too intense for most people.
reply: You kidding? That's like, the best part! The whole reason you'd ride a roller coaster!

2.discuss: Imagine NOT strapping in...

220.text: Whoopsie. I may have gone over budget.

reply: Hang on Shangri La, I thought you of all people would have good self-control?
Impulse spending gets even the best of us, I'm afraid.

2.discuss: Psst~ You can spend all your money from the comfort of your own room by shopping online~
