You flatter me, Commandant! I am only doing my duty.

2.discuss: Excellent work! You make me proud.

301.text: If you wish to see the Commander during office hours, you must first book an appointment.

1.discuss: Living up to your name, I see.
reply: Just doing my job as a palace guard!

2.discuss: What if I have urgent business?
reply: I'm sure you can gain permission to enter if you explain the situation.
To do that, we need to see the Commander first, don't we?
That's why you book an appointment. JK, I'll relay your message in times like that.

1.discuss: Do I need to book an appointment too?
reply: If you want to. You make the rules.
Of course, but I do want to sortie sometime soon. Standing guard all day is a bit boring.

2.discuss: Keep up the good work.

302.text: Sod going outside on my day off. I'll be relaxing in my room instead.

1.discuss: But there are so many fun things you can do outside!
reply: Fun though they may be, they're draining. Holidays are a time to recover your energy, not spend it all.

2.discuss: It must've been a tiresome week for you. I say you should spend your day however you please.
reply: See? Illustrious gets it.
Then how about we listen to some music? That's a pleasant activity one can still do indoors.

3.discuss: hey wanna pop into the napping club and catch some z's with the gang
reply: Napping club? That doesn't sound half-bad...

1.discuss: Enjoy your time off. You've earned it.
reply: Thank you, Commander. The next time we're both free, you should join me so we can laze around together.

303.text: I've finished caring for the little cat. She'll be fine, it was just a scratch.

1.discuss: glad to hear it! i was sooo worried when i found her limping!! thanks for patching her up ('◇')ゞ
reply: Don't mention it. It's my job to help the wounded, be they shipgirl, animal, or human.

2.discuss: Did you make sure it's not infected...?
reply: I applied a dash of antiseptic. The wound will heal in no time.

3.discuss: Excellent work, Doctor Jarvis. You make me proud~
reply: You flatter me, Vestal. I can only dream of one day helping people as much as you do.
Aww, don't be so humble. You're outstanding in your own regard!

1.discuss: I'm so glad healthcare is free at this port.
reply: It's one of the perks of being in the navy. If you ever need treatment, come see me, Commander.
It's a little flashy, but it does its job. That's all that matters.

2.discuss: That's a cute E collar you gave her.

304.text: I think I'll go with this pair today.

1.discuss: Goodness, you have so many gloves. Are they all spares?
reply: All spares. A Royal Knight must dress her best both inside and out. That's why I keep a stockpile of spares, just in case.

2.discuss: I can only imagine how much time it takes to launder all those...
reply: It's a huge chore indeed. When a pair gets too dirty or damaged, it's faster to just replace it.
Discarded and replaced... The same will happen to me if I become too dirty...
Please, you shouldn't liken yourself to a pair of gloves. You're better than that.

3.discuss: An impressive collection. But do you have a dueling gauntlet, Bellona? I challenge you for your star chips!
reply: Huh? If it's a duel you're issuing, I accept. What shall we use? Swords? Guns?

1.discuss: So THAT'S the secret to your elegance.
reply: It's far from the only component of it, but it certainly plays a part.
Haha! Yes, my liege. In love and war.

2.discuss: Is there ever a time the gloves come off?

305.text: Seems this Royal Knight is in quite the hurry today!

1.discuss: Please pardon my unbecoming stride! I was in a rush to deliver those documents to the Commander!
reply: No need to apologise. Sometimes one must charge ahead at full speed.

2.discuss: So that's who I heard running down the corridor just earlier...
reply: Sorry if I disturbed you! It won't happen again!
Heh I nearly bumped into her on the way. Maybe next time!
What, were you TRYING to headbutt her? Behave, Glowworm!

1.discuss: You were just in time. Thanks for the help.
reply: It's my pleasure being of assistance!

306.text: The night's put me in the mood for a glass or two.

1.discuss: Just don't get wasted! I am NOT gonna carry you back to your room again!
reply: Aww, are you worried I'll have too much? Consider joining me then. Drinking together is much more fun.
Who said I was WORRIED about you? I just don't wanna deal with the aftermath! And I don't feel like drinking tonight!
Heheh~ You really get easier to tease as the years go on.

2.discuss: Drinking in moderation now and then is fine. Just don't have too much.
reply: It's only a glass or two, like I said.
girl you have a history of having way too much lmao

1.discuss: That was a great time. Looking forward to the next one.
reply: Hehe, next time's going to be even better. You'll see~

307.text: What in the seven seas happened to this place?! I'm expected to clean all this?!

1.discuss: Must have been the storm that blew through yesterday. What a terrible mess.
reply: I thought as a temp maid I'd only be sweeping floors!
Well... Think of it as a learning opportunity. You'll walk away with good experience.

2.discuss: Apologies for my delayed response. I have sent someone there to assist you.
reply: I appreciate the help, though I never said I couldn't do it all on my own...

1.discuss: Good lord. Do you need a hand with that?
reply: I'll manage... Nothing I can't fix with a little elbow grease!

308.text: I tried my hand at making Dragon Empery-style cookies for the occasion!

1.discuss: My, Howe. This is an incredible level of detail.
reply: It's not my finest work, but I enjoyed making them. I must credit Aurora for providing me with references.
You're welcome. They turned out gorgeous, I have to say.

2.discuss: This is much more in line with what a fortune cookie should be. Well done!
reply: Thank you. I hope I succeeded in capturing the Dragon Empery spirit.

3.discuss: They taste as good as they look! Thanks for giving me some!
reply: I'm glad you liked them.

1.discuss: It feels like a crime eating something so picturesque...
reply: Letting them go to waste would be an even bigger crime, no? I can make more whenever you'd like, Commander.

309.text: Meh. This cup's too small for my liking. Lemme chug.

1.discuss: That's the thing about tea, you're meant to savor the aroma and drink it in small sips!
reply: Oh. That goes against everything I'm used to though.
you really shouldn't chug piping hot tea unless you want second degree burns in your throat.
That's a price I'm willing to pay. Chugging is a way of life.

2.discuss: Boil another pot of tea and I'll fetch some canteens! Let's see who can chug faster!
reply: Yikes, even I know this sounds like a bad idea!
Seriously, this is NOT something you should try at home!

1.discuss: I'd listen to the Empery girls if I were you.
reply: Aww. All I want is to live free and chug...
You'll do that? Thanks, Comrade Commander!

2.discuss: Let's get you something more chuggable.

310.text: Thanks to Chiyoda for styling my hair for the banquet. And sis, sorry it took so long.

1.discuss: Don't be sorry! I can't let your silky hair look anything less than perfect on such a big day.
reply: Was it really worth your whole morning, though?
Every minute spent combing through each strand was worth it!

2.discuss: aww it's sweet seeing sisters as close as you
reply: If you ever want me to do your hair, just say it, sis.
wouldn't it be the other way around though. are you sure you know how to do someone else's hair
I mean... I can practice it! That's why I'm offering!

1.discuss: Looking forward to seeing it later today.
reply: I can't wait for everyone to see my work. You're gonna love it!

311.text: I've decided to pick up a new instrument.

1.discuss: That's what you're up to? Aww, I thought we could have a girls' night out today...
reply: This will take a while, sorry. We'll have to save it for another time.
Hmph... Fine. If you don't have time for a meetup, perhaps I'll bring the meetup to you!

2.discuss: How pleasant. Learning an instrument is both a good pastime and a way to become more cultured.
reply: You should practice one yourself, sister. You'd surely become proficient in no time.
Maybe so. I will give it some thought.

1.discuss: Your performance was great. Keep it up!
reply: Thanks for stopping by to listen. I still have much practice to do before I master the flute, however.

312.text: I dedicate this performance to the Commander~

1.discuss: So you were the source of that tempestuous symphony... I should've expected no less.
reply: Thank you! I'm glad you think my piece was characteristic of me.

2.discuss: It was certainly shocking. I never thought a piano could produce such sounds.
reply: It all comes down to the player's heart. You get what you put in.
That is a fascinating glimpse into your mind.

1.discuss: All I'll say is it left me speechless.
reply: That's exactly what I was going for~

313.text: I've been told hiding your mouth with a fan looks graceful. I feel a little naked, though...

1.discuss: Not every day you see Boise without the mask.
reply: I mean, it's improper to wear one to a banquet. Plus, this fan works well enough...
Good points. I'll say, it makes you look pretty.

2.discuss: The fan suits you well. There's nothing to be embarrassed about.
reply: Thank you for the compliment...

3.discuss: Helena's right. You've got such cute looks, and no reason to hide them.
reply: I do... But thank you...

1.discuss: That's a pretty pattern on it.
reply: Mhm. I think it's really nice.
Thank you...

2.discuss: You look stunning.

314.text: This will be my first banquet, and I'm so tense... Need to look sharp!

1.discuss: Take it easy. A knight must face all situations calmly and head-on!
reply: You're right! I need to look sharp, but I can't lose my composure.

2.discuss: I've got some advice for how to destress if you need it
reply: You do? By all means, let's hear it!
It's easy, just say screw the banquet and find a place you can be alone and veg out
That's not a solution! That's just skipping out on my duties!

1.discuss: Deep breaths. Take some time to mentally prepare.
reply: I will! I'll form a plan for the evening and try to follow it!
That makes me feel a little more confident in myself. Thank you, Commander!

2.discuss: You look great. You've got nothing to worry about.

315.text: I think I've gotten completely lost in this mirror maze! Send help!

1.discuss: Next time, trace the wall like I showed and you'll eventually find the way out.
reply: Thank you for rescuing me! I'd never have made it out without you, Suruga!!
Don't mention it. Just be careful from now on.

2.discuss: How? The maze isn't particularly big.
reply: Seeing myself reflected in all directions made me lose my bearings...

3.discuss: I'm terribly sorry the maze put you through such distress. I should have exercised foresight.
reply: Don't be sorry! People getting lost in your maze is proof that it's a well-designed maze, after all!

1.discuss: How long were you lost in there?
reply: Not for too long, thanks to Suruga! The white rabbit was shown the way home!

316.text: Am I really supposed to just... lie here to play my role?

1.discuss: Unless I'm mistaken, aren't you meant to play Red Riding Hood, not the Sleeping Beauty?
reply: Le Malin said this is the best way to \"get in touch with my vulnerable side,\" so...

2.discuss: Looking good! God I wish my rehearsals were as laid-back as yours... Anyway! Keep it up! Your role is important!
reply: Of course! I shall put my nose to the grindstone!

3.discuss: I see your rehearsal is going well. I look forward to the live performance.
reply: Hmph! You're no match for me, wolf!
I don't believe Little Red Riding Hood fares well against the wolf in the original story. Nevertheless, the live performance will surely be interesting.

1.discuss: You're not worried about dozing off?
reply: Hah! I am not so easily pacified by cozy cushions and warm sheets!

317.text: May I interest anyone in a juicy, shiny red apple?

1.discuss: Hang on, isn't this that killer apple? One bite and you're worm food!
reply: If so, then I fear Snow White may no longer be with us...
If this were a fairy tale, you'd be right. This apple, however, is ordinary in every way save for its excellent flavor.

2.discuss: Since you'll be playing Snow White, perhaps an adjustment to the script is in order.
reply: You think so? What sort of change are you proposing?
How about... Snow White takes the Seven Dwarves with her, rescues the prince, and brings down judgment upon the wicked queen?
Well... It's not a bad idea per se.

1.discuss: It may not kill you, but does it put you to sleep?
reply: Oh? Do you wish to play the part of the princess waiting for her Prince Charming to save her?

318.text: A wolf must be patient and strike only when the time is right.

1.discuss: But in the last moment, Little Red Riding Hood escapes by the skin of her teeth?
reply: All I'll say is that, when my prey enters my sights, the outcome is sure to be quite one-sided.

2.discuss: you know, it never sat right with me how some versions of the story end. no way in hell would a little girl survive an encounter with a damn wolf.
reply: Sure, she wouldn't in real life. But in a tale with a story to tell, it's fair game! Right?

3.discuss: I'm not scared of you, wolf! I'll make a fur coat out of you!
reply: sounds like little red riding hood here won't go down without a fight... that's what I like to see.
We shall see if the hunter doth become the hunted, come the live performance. Until then... Heehee.

1.discuss: It'll be a while before she arrives. Try to stay awake.
reply: A determined wolf does not rest for one minute until it has achieved its goal.

319.text: \"What's in a name? That which we call a rose, by any other name would smell as sweet.\"

1.discuss: Reciting your lines, I presume?
reply: Yup. I've been rehearsing both the male and female leads, but I'm still not sure which I wanna play in the end, lol.

2.discuss: That is incredible, Biloxi! Meanwhile, I'm having enough trouble memorizing just ONE set of lines...
reply: My advice: try to really, really immerse yourself into your role. Then memorizing your lines should become a breeze.
Ooh! So simple, yet so brilliant! Thank you, I'll be sure to give it a try!

1.discuss: You still need someone to play the other role, don't you?
reply: Are you interested in being that someone, Commander? Then do you wanna be Romeo... or Juliet? Heh.
I promise you're not gonna be disappointed.

2.discuss: Can't wait for the live performance!

320.text: I will admit I am quite particular when it comes to props.

1.discuss: Props, no pun intended, to the Royal Maids for helping set the stage!
reply: No need to thank me, I was only doing my job. Besides, it was rather enjoyable.

2.discuss: We owe every successful play to the countless people who work hard behind the scenes.
reply: Yup! Let's take a moment to appreciate the unsung heroes of the theatric world!

3.discuss: You're a right talented lass, Enterprise. Maid work and stage dressing are child's play for you, eh?
reply: Please, my skills are middling at best. Everyone else deserves more praise than me.

1.discuss: Great job setting the stage!
reply: It's my pleasure, Master. You deserve praise as well for your part in making everything come together.

1.discuss: Behold, the (prototype) Vroomulator Chariot! Custom-made for Roma by yours truly!
reply: A prototype, you say? I cannot wait to see what the finished version is capable of.
I guarantee you it won't disappoint!

2.discuss: What are you doing atop a chariot?
reply: Spreading our splendor across the port!
Ah, how magnificent. Keep it up.

3.discuss: That's a hell of a way to repurpose some motorcycles... Maybe I'll make my own silver chariot.
reply: Throw me a DM if you want a hand with that! I can do whatever custom job you want!

1.discuss: Thanks for patrolling around port.
reply: It's all part of the job. Coupled with the splendor-spreading, it was two birds with one stone.
Ahah. Riding a chariot is a supreme joy. Would you like to ride with me sometime, Commander?

2.discuss: Now that's the splendor people clamor for!

322.text: Check out my latest invention! I call it the Doggo Cattron 3000!

1.discuss: What does it do?
reply: It's a robot pet designed for people who love cats and dogs equally! This little kitty goes woof-woof!
So it's like... a dog with the body of a cat? Neato.

2.discuss: Fascinating! What's the internal structure like? I need to know!
reply: You can examine it all you want if you help me with some ideas I've yet to implement! Deal?
Deal!

3.discuss: You've made a cat that's not a cat?
reply: Bingo! What are your thoughts about that?
It's uh... weird? I don't get the point of it?
Alas, the world is not yet ready. But you'll see the appeal before long!

1.discuss: I want one so badly.
reply: Then I'll make a Kitty Dogbot variant just for you, Commander!

323.text: You know what complements a cozy afternoon? Tea with pastries, what else!

1.discuss: Just like a nice afternoon is made even better with cake, a nice cake is made even better with warm tea.
reply: It sure is. You Royal Navy ladies definitely know your stuff when it comes to afternoon tea.
I'm humbled. Our doors are open for you if you'd like to personally attend one of our tea parties.
I'd be right happy to.

2.discuss: What is that huge stack of papers?
reply: Fear not, sis. This paperwork is due this evening.
Enjoying tea while you have this much unfinished work is incredibly poor conduct in this dignitary's eyes.
Relax, I'm just having a break. I'll get it done in a flash afterward.

1.discuss: It's all about working hard but not too hard.
reply: Well said! Breaks are a must to prevent burnout.

324.text: I make a habit of taking notes whenever I see something new in nature.

1.discuss: Lookout, give me a report! What have you seen?
reply: Some gorgeous valleys, trees, and lakes, to start with.

2.discuss: Aww man! I wish I could go on vacation too!
reply: A vacation? I'm not sure hikes qualify as vacations.
Hikes are fun though! And you get to see new things and places, just like on a vacation!
I see... I suppose you could call it a micro-vacation.

1.discuss: Let's find some new vistas together next time!
reply: Sure, that'd be great.

325.text: Extra, extra, read all the hottest happenings in the latest edition of the Port Journal!

1.discuss: At last! I'll have one copy.
reply: Sold! Thanks for your patronage!

2.discuss: What kind of happenings? You know what, I'll have one too!
reply: Probably not the kind you think, Libeccio.
This thing is loaded with things I never knew... Guess I've got a rival in journalism now.
Rivals? No! We can be partners, trading scoops and stuff!
Ooh. I like the sound of that.

3.discuss: What are your sources for some the stuff written in this thing?
reply: Trade secret, can't say!

1.discuss: Now I'm wondering what's written in it...
reply: I'll put aside a copy just for you, Commander! Give it a read and lemme know what you think!

326.text: I watched a play. The script and performances were so excellent I remember every little detail of them.

1.discuss: So 5/5 stars? Two thumbs up?
reply: Yes. That's my glowing recommendation.

2.discuss: Hold up, when? A little bird told me no stage production is scheduled in the theater today.
reply: That's not wrong. I've been replaying the whole play in my head here in the theater hall. If I focus, it's like I'm really attending a live performance.
I can picture the beautiful things I've seen if I close my eyes, so I think I know what you mean?

1.discuss: Let's go watch a new one sometime soon.
reply: Of course, Commander, if you'd like to!

327.text: A crispy shell complemented by a juicy filling that bursts in the mouth. Ah, what a culinary masterwork.

1.discuss: I never knew your fondness of tempura extended quite THAT far...
reply: It matters not how or what food is made of. If it pleases the palate, it is to be extolled.
That is certainly true!

2.discuss: In that case, I shall include it at tonight's banquet.
reply: Why, thank you. I look forward to savoring it.
I can confidently say it will live up to your expectations.

3.discuss: It would seem... it's a favorite amongst destroyers as well...
reply: You should taste it yourself, my sister. I'll dispatch a courier your way.
If you insist, then I shall...

1.discuss: I'm up for another tempura feast anytime.
reply: Delightful to hear it's to your tastes. Yes, I concur.

328.text: My present for the Commander iiis... daifuku filled with strawberries and love!

1.discuss: I know I'd love em if I got em. Juicy red strawberries coupled with pearly white mochi are to die for~
reply: Mhm! I hope the Commander will echo your sentiment!

2.discuss: Why is one of them half-eaten?
reply: It's not half-eaten, just, you know, cut in half for the sake of a better picture!
Cut in half, you say? Then how'd that crumb get onto your cheek?

3.discuss: You've inspired me to try making some daifuku of my own.
reply: Oh really? Give me a call when they're done, I want to see them for myself!
Okay! I can't promise they'll turn out any good though.

1.discuss: They taste superb. 10/10!
reply: Thank you! Be sure to finish them all and savor my love in its entirety~

329.text: I have confidential papers I must deliver to the Commander posthaste!

1.discuss: Oh, you were in rush? That explains why you just ran past.
reply: Forgive me! I was so focused on my mission I didn't think to stop and say hi.

2.discuss: It's probably not the smartest idea to tell the whole world you're carrying around secret documents...
reply: They've already been delivered, so I believe it's no issue.
Already? Well then...

3.discuss: Look at that zoom blur! You must be going extremely fast!
reply: Right you are. I will run with every cell in my body if so required of me!

1.discuss: THAT was quick. Appreciate it, Wakatsuki.
reply: It's my honor to be in your service!

330.text: Oh, will this weather ever abate...

1.discuss: Rain sucks. It makes the air humid as heck and sends rabbits into hiding...
reply: Bad weather puts me in a bad mood. When the clouds cry... it makes me sad...

2.discuss: I've got an idea. We'll make rain charms and send those storm clouds packing!
reply: Do rain charms actually work...?
They do if you believe in 'em! Sit tight, I'll make a couple and we'll hang them up in your room later.
Alright... Thanks, Fubuki...

1.discuss: Don't worry. The sun will be back before you know it.
reply: You're right. It can't rain forever... Thanks for cheering me up, Commander...

331.text: just lowkey rescued a cat from a tree, ama

1.discuss: How'd you find the cat? And how'd you even get up there?
reply: i just heard meowing among the leaves while i was hanging around in the treetops lol
You know it's dangerous up there, right? You're lucky you didn't fall and break something.
true that... i'll try to stick to the ground as much as i can

2.discuss: I was going to call you out as well, but you DID save that poor cat, so I'll look the other way this once.
reply: i know it's dangerous, ok? i won't be climbing up any more trees (unless i have to)
You're fine as long as you remember that. Also, what did you do with the cat afterwards?
it just ran off right after i let it go so idk. probably chasing rats by now

1.discuss: Thanks for patrolling the port at night. You're doing god's work.
reply: i was just chilling in a tree cause i felt restless but i'll take the compliment

332.text: A relaxing haven away from the summer's lingering rays, a perfect opportunity to clear one's mind.

1.discuss: \"A single moment of leisure, snatched from an eternity of labor.\" A literal breath of fresh air, so to speak~
reply: It is always good to snatch some free time for yourself, but there's something else I'd like to get my hands on. Heehee~

2.discuss: Are we going swimming? Hang on, let me get my bikini!
reply: No. Don't even think about ruining her peace and quiet.
It wouldn't bother me at all. She's than welcome to swim if she'd like. In fact, the more the merrier. Why not bring some friends while at it?
Heck yeah! I'll shoot a DM to Ping Hai and Ying Swei!

3.discuss: You know what'd make it even better? Chilling with some ice cream!
reply: THIS! Let's go to the store and buy a whole box!
Escaping the heat with something sweet. That has a nice ring to it.

1.discuss: That's one of my favorite spots to catch a break from the sun.
reply: To paraphrase an old proverb: to a wise general, knowing when to rest is just as important as knowing when to strike.

333.text: Don't be shy, King Teddylot! Help yourself!

1.discuss: maaan I could kill for some of that cake...
reply: Nobody has to die today. I've set aside a slice just for thou!
wait really? aw yis! you da best knight ever!
But of course I am! Incidentally, thou art always welcome to my tea parties, my sister!
you bet I'm gonna take you up on that

2.discuss: Few things enrich a leisure day like tea and desserts. Wouldn't you agree?
reply: Of course, Cardinal! Why wouldn't I agree? Your wisdom is unquestionable!
No need to get so worked up, my knight. You're free to disagree if you feel differently.
Certainly! I mean, I don't! I mean... okay!

1.discuss: For once, I wish I was a teddy bear...
reply: You needn't be King Teddylot to attend my tea party, Lord Commander! You may join if you so like!

334.text: A toast! To this magnificent day and to this awesome banquet!

1.discuss: I look forward to our annual banquet more than anything else the whole year! Well, maybe except for Christmas.
reply: Hah! Both are great times to get together and have a good time with friends and family.

2.discuss: Ooh, is that champagne?
reply: No, this is Nevada. Heh. But yeah, you oughta try it once you're older!

3.discuss: Cmon let's skip the toasts and get straight to the drinking part!
reply: I have a fun idea. Why don't we see who can hold their liquor best? I'll be waiting at the vacant table~
You're on, princess! Nobody drinks me under the table!

1.discuss: And I'll raise a toast to all of you wonderful people!
reply: I'll drink to that! Remember, we wouldn't be here today without you, Commander!

335.text: [The Annual Banquet] Lady Nagato has put on her party attire and will be joining the banquet shortly.

1.discuss: Heheh! The photo came out pretty good, right, sis?
reply: I've told you countless times, Mutsu... This account is ONLY for announcements! Use your own to comment on posts.
I know, I know, I just forgot to swap!
Lol it happened again? Never stop, Mutsu, because it's hilarious.

2.discuss: Wow. Now you truly look the part of a dignified flagship! ;)
reply: Please, Great Veteran, don't mock me so...
Personally, I think it's a marvelous dress. It deserves praise.
I cannot tell if you're sincere or not...

1.discuss: It genuinely looks great on you.
reply: I'll choose to believe you're being sincere... Thank you for the compliment.

336.text: Feast your eyes upon my splendid new dress!

1.discuss: \"Splendid\" really is the word! You're literally glimmering! *o*
reply: Why, thank you! Filters and postprocessing are like magic sometimes~

2.discuss: Gosh. You're as bright as a whole constellation. I wish I could be like you...
reply: You flatter me, Juneau! Also, you most definitely can be. You just have to be confident in yourself!
I suppose, though that's easier said than done for me...

1.discuss: Beautiful. Like the shimmering blue sea.
reply: Thank you, Commander! Might I mention you're quite good-looking yourself? Heheh~

337.text: I visited a garden and played with some super friendly swans today!

1.discuss: Aww, they're so sweet! Doesn't being around animals just make you all warm inside? ♡♡♡
reply: Mhm! It feels strangely soothing feeding and petting them, too.
Can I come with you some other time? I wanna make friends with them too!
Absolutely! I'm sure they'd love to play with you.

2.discuss: Hey how come they're so calm around you but they run away when I get close???
reply: Maybe because you run at them, shouting \"hey white duckies, let's play\"? I'd be startled too if I were a swan...
Be calm with them, and they'll be calm with you, I think...

1.discuss: I'm sure those swans loved your company.
reply: I loved their company too. It almost felt like they were nicer to me than I was to them.

338.text: I got the kitties all dressed up for Halloween!

1.discuss: aww cute!! (≧▽≦)
reply: Hopefully they'll make trick-or-treating feel less stressful for me...
I'm sure they will! good luck tonight janus (^.^)b

2.discuss: Just don't expect too much from them. Cats are whimsical creatures.
reply: That's true... but these cats are well-behaved and wouldn't do that. Probably...

3.discuss: Nice cat ears~ My grand catification plan is progressing swimmingly >:3
reply: I'm... not sure what you're talking about, but I'm happy to hear it I guess?

1.discuss: Ah, you've started a little witch a-cat-demia.
reply: Hehe, I guess you could say that. They'll make great purr-cerers one day.

339.text: Tonight I am not simply Albion, I am Albion the Devil Childe.

1.discuss: Does that mean you're the Childe of a devil, or a devil who is a Childe?
reply: Well, the two aren't mutually exclusive, are they? The latter might be a more apt description, however.
That is a good point. Perhaps next year I will dress up as your Elder devil counterpart.
Or we could be dark elves, or faeries. Whatever the case, I suppose you'll always be my Elder.

2.discuss: Bet you're gonna make a killing trick or treating in that spicy getup~
reply: I hope so! It'll feel strange eliciting treats from my Elders, but that is in the spirit of the holiday, so... Trick or treat, Elder Abercrombie!
Aw shoot, I should've kept my gob shut!

1.discuss: How delightfully devilish.
reply: Thank you, Commander. I hope you'll be ready to give out treats, or be subject to a trick when I stop by.

340.text: umm. this is mingin so I clearly did something wrong.

1.discuss: What were you making? Some sort of potion?
reply: would you believe me if I said pumpkin risotto?
Pumpkin risotto sounds like a potion to me...
you know what, yeah. it's a potion.

2.discuss: What have I told you about leaving the cooking to the professionals?
reply: I know I know but I won't improve if I don't practice, will I?
Forget it, I'll do it for you. Wait in the kitchen and don't touch anything else.
oh, cheers!

1.discuss: I'm impressed you managed to turn it green...
reply: green's healthy though, innit? I wouldn't touch it with a ten foot pole though.

341.text: Fire cannons! Jack-o'-lanturn them to scrap!

1.discuss: Hah! I know I'd be scared if I saw a mighty big pumpkin flying right at me.
reply: Right? That's what gave me the idea.

2.discuss: A direct hit from that would knock somebody's teeth out. I approve.
reply: Don't be silly! If we can take cannon shells, we can handle a few pumpkins.

3.discuss: It'd be cooler if we could fire candy through the cannon instead...
reply: Who says we can't? Manjuus, load the candy corn and chocolate!
Oh yeah! Sweet!

1.discuss: Are you thinking what I'm thinking, Oklahoma?
reply: A team battle with pumpkin cannons on both sides? That'd be the best Halloween activity ever!

1.discuss: I love seeing you perform alchemy despite having no idea how any of it works!
reply: how on earth did you turn those ingredients into something completely different...
That's what alchemy is all about! Isn't it amazing?

2.discuss: Being thrown into another world won't stop you from synthesizing, huh?
reply: Nope! Wherever I end up, I'll always be an alchemist.

3.discuss: Is that... a witch's cauldron?
reply: Close! It's an alchemy cauldron. You put things in it, mix 'em, and out comes something new.

1.discuss: Is it true you can make just about everything?
reply: With the right ingredients... probably?

343.text: I helped out at the store today.

1.discuss: I appreciate it, nya! Having a smart, diligent assistant makes all the difference, nya.
reply: I'm happy to help if it means learning new things from you and Shiranui.

2.discuss: Your expertise is evident. You give us both a run for our money.
reply: Heheh. I AM the daughter of a merchant, so yeah.

3.discuss: Looks like you're adapting well to life in this place. You love to see it!
reply: Yup. I'm glad you're doing the same, Ryza.

1.discuss: Thanks for helping around the port.
reply: Don't mention it. It's the least I could do.

344.text: With a new world comes new knowledge, and I have learned a lot of it.

1.discuss: Any teacher would love to teach someone as committed to learning as you, Patricia. Keep it up.
reply: You flatter me, Miss Pennsylvania. I am forever grateful for your guidance.

2.discuss: Studying's cool, but have you considered joining a club? The gardening and basketball clubs would welcome you ;D
reply: Those do sound intriguing. I will give it some thought!
Hey, take your time. Just hit us up if you wanna give it a try.

1.discuss: Sounds like you're a model student.
reply: You should always strive to learn new things wherever you go.

345.text: So many new plants I've never seen before... This world is fascinating.

1.discuss: It delights me to speak to someone who shares my passion for flowers.
reply: And I'm glad to speak to someone who can share her extensive knowledge about them.
Think nothing of it. I'm happy to.

2.discuss: Oh, you dig plants too? I just got my hands on some new bonsai seedlings, you wanna plant some with me?
reply: Seedlings? I'd like to have a look, at least.
Sure thing! :D

1.discuss: I hope you'll find the plant you're looking for.
reply: Thank you. It's heartening to know people are rooting for you.

346.text: Rigging training is indispensible, but so is daily muscle training.

1.discuss: Feels good to work out, doesn't it?
reply: Yeah. I'm also amazed how many exercise machines you have in this world.

2.discuss: The way you fight is profoundly impressive to me, Miss Lila! Could we spar together again later?
reply: Sure. I'm always up for an opportunity to learn more from my fellow warriors.

3.discuss: You have the mindset of a truly formidable warrior. I respect that.
reply: As do you, Enterprise. I believe we both have things to learn from each other.
Are you proposing a friendly exercise? I'm game as long as the Commander approves it.

1.discuss: You hold yourself to really high standards, don't you?
reply: As a warrior should. Training is the key to reaching new heights.

347.text: Activating combat command systems! Locking on to all targets!

1.discuss: I don't know what all the meters and gauges are for, but I can tell you mean business.
reply: Heh. Let's just say my power level is off the charts.

2.discuss: Dayum! What are you controlling there? A mech?
reply: I wish! As baller as it looks, it's sadly just a movie prop.

3.discuss: Whoooa! This feels like something out of a superhero movie!
reply: Haha, yeah! Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it's Superhornet!

1.discuss: I'll see if the R&D team can make something like this.
reply: You're gonna make a real one? Oh hell yeah.

348.text: Oh goodness, the world is spinning haha...

1.discuss: Are you drunk again?
reply: No not at all! See i cab drill type like normal

2.discuss: You're clearly drunk out of your mind. I'll send Vestal your way.
reply: Come onnnn hornet, I'm not durnk!

3.discuss: Oh no... I told you to stay away from the wine, Yorktown!
reply: I blame her type II rigging. It made her overestimate her own alcohol tolerance.
Why didn't anyone stop her?!
You couldn't even if you tried... But hey, no biggie. Vestal's looking after her.

1.discuss: Remember: everything in moderation.
reply: I only had a few glasses! It's no big deal

349.text: Choices, choices... Which should I wear today?

1.discuss: Why not let the Commander decide? \"Hey, which makes me look the cutest~?\"
reply: What?! No way in hell! I'd die from embarrassment if I asked that outright!
Outright~? So you ARE looking to dress to impress the Commander.
Am not! Although... I guess maybe that's a small, small part of it...

2.discuss: Yes, yeees... The cat ear crusade has reached the shores of the Eagle Union! >:3
reply: I'm not part of any dumb crusade!

3.discuss: They all look good on you, Hammann.
reply: Thank you! Although that makes it even harder to pick one...

1.discuss: You look cute in all of them ToT
reply: Flattery won't get you far with me, okay?! I'm so NOT over the moon!

350.text: Reading \"Adventures in the Forest of Fables.\" It's harder to follow than I expected...

1.discuss: Isn't that a children's book? How is it hard to follow?
reply: The plot moves super fast and the pacing is all over the place. It's like the story changes from one chapter to the next.

2.discuss: Wait a second! Isn't that the name of the escape room scenario we ran not that long ago?
reply: Oh, don't remind me. The cleanup afterwards was horrific...
They should've let me portray the Black Knight instead of Little Red Riding Hood!
So wait, doesn't that make this nonfiction?
I believe the phrase \"based on a true story\" is applicable here.

1.discuss: They made a book of it? Where are my royalties?
reply: Were you the \"human lost in the forest\"? That would explain a few things...

351.text: This will be on the exam, so make sure you review it closely!

1.discuss: I can't be at the exam because a dog ate my homework~
reply: That's unfortunate. I'll print out copies and bring them to your room.
Err, never mind, teach! The dog just coughed it up in one piece (real btw)!

2.discuss: I see you've installed a fancy new blackboard!
reply: Indeed I have. I can even use my pointer with it.
Hooray for technology! This should make teaching more efficient.

1.discuss: We should install these all around the academy.
reply: Agreed. One of their main benefits is aiding distance learning for students who can't attend class.

352.text: Let's see if I can work out the most effective use of our Spring Festival budget...

1.discuss: Geesh! You're counting faster than the camera can track!
reply: Oh, you're right. I suppose it's because I'm used to this.

2.discuss: I might as well not even be here, considering how quickly you work... Sigh...
reply: That's not true. I appreciate having you around.
Well... Thank you, I suppose.

3.discuss: Holy mackerel, nya! I could use someone with a knack for accounting like you at my store, nya.
reply: I'd certainly be willing to do that. My only question is: what's the pay?

1.discuss: You don't have to minmax. We've got a sizable budget.
reply: I know it's sizable. That's why I want to work out a plan to maximize it!

353.text: One spring incantation, coming right up!

1.discuss: Woah... Can you really do magic?
reply: To a degree. What's most important is your wish to see it grow!

2.discuss: Whenever I plant a seed, I also make a wish for it to grow into a pretty, healthy flower.
reply: And I'll bet it works. Flowers can sense feelings like that.

3.discuss: Can you wish instead of watering it too? ;D
reply: Thoughts and feelings can't replace sustenance...

1.discuss: What other incantations do you know?
reply: Well, what kind are you interested in, our Singing Nightingale?

354.text: A fireplace warms the body. Huddling up warms the heart.

1.discuss: Screw the cold! I'm spending the rest of winter in this cozy room.
reply: Yes, it's cold, but you can't be a shut-in forever. Remember, you still have obligations!
I know, I know. I'll go outside later.

2.discuss: Winter is the season of fighting cold and loneliness together.
reply: Mhm. But to fight the latter, you need the grace of a warm heart.
Couple shots of vodka should do the trick! Always warms my heart!

1.discuss: Staying home sounds nice, but so does a snowball fight.
reply: You can only do one or the other, Commander. Do you want to huddle up in my room, or go outside and play in the snow?

1.discuss: Halloween was months ago! The Spring Festival isn't about ghosts!
reply: I just thought it'd be fun to spice things up this year...

2.discuss: Oh man, I love being a ghost! You should've seen the look on An Shan's face LMAO
reply: Err... These comments are public, remember?
I TOLD you to stop scaring people, Fu Shun! Do I have to ground you again?
Okay, okay, I'll stop!

1.discuss: I approve of this collision of cultures.
reply: Why don't you join in yourself, Commander? I think you'd rock as a jiangshi.

356.text: There is beauty to be found even in the biting cold of winter.

1.discuss: The night whisks in the spring breeze; the next morn, a thousand petals adorn the trees. That is the poem you are referring to, yes?
reply: Indeed. We are blessed to get to admire such beautiful sights in this cold weather.

2.discuss: I dunno about you, but when I see a tree covered in snow, I just wanna shake it!
reply: Especially if someone's sitting under it, right?
Ehh... Then I'll pass. Last time I did that, that someone was An Shan...
RIP.

3.discuss: The icicles and soft snow both look kinda yummy... I wonder how they taste.
reply: don't even think about it! you'll get sick!

1.discuss: It sure is beautiful. Here's to another good year.
reply: I'm certain it will be, as long as you're with us.

357.text: Let me sing for you the story of our Champion.

1.discuss: Let us hear it. What adventures does this champion embark on?
reply: It begins with the Champion's departure for battle, and ends in a triumphant return.

2.discuss: The masses may love embellished tales, but I'd prefer hearing about this champion's more pedestrian anecdotes.
reply: I have no idea what she just said, but I wanna hear something spicy!
I'd need the Champion's permission to divulge such things.
I'm clearly missing something here. Who the hell is \"our champion\"?

1.discuss: Who comes up with all these tales, anyway?
reply: Comes up with? Why, they are based on the true story of our Champion!

358.text: Rejoice, Commander, for I have finished cleaning.

1.discuss: As in, disposed of a threat? I don't believe there are any enemies in the vicinity of the port.
reply: Many spots around the office were long overdue a thorough tidying, so I took it upon myself.
What you MEAN by \"tidying\" and \"cleaning\"?! Please tell me you didn't do anything drastic!
What is there to clarify? I used a set of tools to take care of some filth.

2.discuss: So YOU'RE behind that loud boom that came from the office?
reply: Yes. Rest assured, I've already dealt with the resulting dust and debris.
Well, splendid job, but that's not the issue here!

1.discuss: That's... one way to do spring cleaning.
reply: You're welcome, Commander.

359.text: It's all or nothing when it comes to shopping! I'll take your whole stock!

1.discuss: My angel has descended from heaven to secure my financial future forever, nya! Thank you, nya!
reply: Hah! You're welcome, li'l merchant. But I expect a discount next time.

2.discuss: Goodness me, that's a lot of money.
reply: What can I say? LNY is a big holiday, and I'm a big spender.

3.discuss: sure that stuff is necessary, but you don't NEED to go all out, do you?
reply: There's a time to exercise moderation, and LNY ain't it! Besides, no problem with splurging if nothing goes to waste, right?
you're not wrong, but at the same time...

1.discuss: Attagirl! Go big or go home!
reply: Damn right! Money's meant to be spent – the more, the better!

360.text: Guess who just pulled an accidental all-nighter.

1.discuss: hum-hum. were you working on something, by any chance?
reply: Yup. I started working on a brilliant idea I had and the next thing I know, it's morning.
Been there, done that. It's easy to lose track of time when inspiration strikes!

2.discuss: Have a shot of vodka. It'll kick you right back into gear!
reply: Good idea. I'll do just that.
Vodka's the last thing you need after an all-nighter! If you insist on drinking, make it warm beer instead.

3.discuss: Please try not to make a habit of staying up late. Have you eaten? I have freshly made borscht, if you'd like.
reply: Sounds lovely. I'll be there in a few.

1.discuss: Maybe you should take the day off.
reply: I'll be fine. That vodka did the drink and I'm back on all pistons now.

361.text: Ahahaha! Worthless plants! I'll cut you all down!

1.discuss: Ah, isn't that the spot they were going to put a new flowerbed?
reply: Wait... You're saying I did someone a FAVOR by doing that?

2.discuss: Are you the Iron Blood Scissorhands I've heard about, Rupprecht? Just curious.
reply: Who? I don't know anything about a \"scissorhands\"!

3.discuss: Feels good, doesn't it? Cutting down everything that stands in your path. It's even more fun when you intentionally leave survivors.
reply: Yeah! Wait, what do you mean \"survivors\"?

1.discuss: Why'd you go grass-cutting out of the blue?
reply: Because I felt like it! Got a problem with that?
Exactly, and I expect a reward for my hard work! Maybe then I'll do something even more impressive next time!

2.discuss: You showed that lawn who's boss.

362.text: I have some special black tea just for you, Commander. I'm sure you'll love it~

1.discuss: You always go above and beyond with your preparation of tea... in both taste and preparation.
reply: I simply strive to seek stimulation from the insipid and mundane parts of daily life~

2.discuss: Lady Implacable... I believe the tea is best left to the professionals...
reply: Why's that? I think I've certainly outdone myself this time!

3.discuss: Hmm? Is that the newest type of instant tea powder?
reply: Uhh... Well, it's supposed to be very healthy for you.

1.discuss: Err, sure, I'll give it a try.
reply: I knew your thirst would win out, Commander~

363.text: Sorting and organising Master's everyday belongings is an essential part of being an excellent maid.

1.discuss: Well done, Scylla. You even make sure to keep us stocked up on sterile earpicks~
reply: I am hardly worthy of the praise. It is simply my job, 'tis all.

2.discuss: With Scylla by your side, you won't have to worry about anything getting lost ever again
reply: It is not some magical power inherent to my being. Proper sorting and organisation is all you need to not lose things.

3.discuss: Huh? So that's where my crown walked off to. Shoot, I already bought a new one...
reply: You're lucky I found it, but make sure to take better care of your belongings next time, Miss Valiant.

1.discuss: Thanks for always keeping things tidy!
reply: I simply do what is expected of me. Are there any other facets of your life you'd like me to manage for you, Master?

364.text: Phew... Barely made it back before curfew...

1.discuss: What curfew...?
reply: Umm, it's just something I hold myself to. \"Return to your nest before the ordained time,\" or something like that?
...Speaking of bird analogies, you look like a chicken that's been dropped in a pot and stewed for a few hours.

2.discuss: You're back later than usual today. Did something happen?
reply: I saw the most beautiful night sky while taking my stroll, and ended up losing track of the time.

1.discuss: What happens if you miss your curfew?
reply: Then, umm, when I get out of bed the next morning...

365.text: Why is my luck always so rotten...

1.discuss: Are you alright?! Do you need me to take you to the hospital?
reply: I'm fine now, Vestal and Jervis were kind enough to take a look at me...

2.discuss: Ohmygosh, I am SO sorry! That was the one I belted outta the ballpark...
reply: It's my fault for letting you get a hit in the first place. Sorry again!
It's okay... Stuff like this happens all the time, so I'm used to it... Ahaha...

3.discuss: Would you like to come visit us at the shrine in the mountains? It's a great way to purify bad luck!
reply: Really? Maybe I'll give it a try then...

1.discuss: Are you sure you're fine? Do you want me to head over there?
reply: Oh... Thanks, but I'd feel bad for using up your precious time ><

366.text: Ooooh, look at this cache I found in the Commander's room! Wonder what's inside~

1.discuss: Hey, hands off the Commander's stuff!
reply: Puh-lease. It's not like I took it with me or opened it. What's wrong with taking a look? Plus, aren't you curious about what scandalous stuff is inside~?
N-not at all!

2.discuss: Did you open it or not? I wanna know if the Commander's got pervy mags in there.
reply: Huuh? I didn't put any points in my lockpicking skill~

1.discuss: Where the heck did you get that...
reply: You can't be a Hero without having a keen sense for treasure~

367.text: Seize the day. Make snowmen before the snow melts.

1.discuss: I love snowmen! And snowcats too. That's what you're making, right?
reply: Mhm, I worked pretty hard on it. Looks nice, doesn't it?
Oh, definitely! I thought you missed my reply for a minute there.
We should have a snowball fight too, before spring sets in.
Sign me up!
Just don't use my snowman for target practice, thanks...

3.discuss: It's getting warmer. Your little guy won't last for long.
reply: I know. Watching snow melt little by little is enjoyable, though.

1.discuss: Cute!
reply: Thanks. You could make a lovely snowman too if you put effort into it, Commander. Give it a try sometime.

368.text: Hmm. This works decently as camouflage.

1.discuss: Disguising as a roadside mascot to spy on people... Not a bad idea.
reply: She looks so warm and fluffy. Makes me wanna run up and hug her!
Yeah... Those aren't exactly the reactions I was going for...

2.discuss: What are you doing dressed as a snowman?
reply: Blending in. Two snowmen side by side ought to look perfectly normal.

3.discuss: Kinda cute. Isn't it cold in there, though?
reply: Maybe if you're not me. I'm built different.

4.discuss: How nice of you to keep my snowman company. Now you're snowbuddies.
reply: Oh, so you built it. Good to know.

1.discuss: All I see are two snowmen...
reply: Good. My prey won't know I'm here until it's too late.

369.text: Spring is here, comrades! Let's celebrate with lots and lots of vodka!

1.discuss: Couldn't have said it better myself! Today we're gonna chug 'til we hit the floor!
reply: Is that a challenge? I'm gonna outdrink you this time!
Them's fighting words. May the best drinker win!

2.discuss: Seems the more people drink, the louder they get...
reply: Her poor liver... You think she's okay?
I saw her stumbling a lot, but she'll be fine. By now, she's probably preparing for her next battle.

3.discuss: My poor snowman...
reply: The question is, was it spring that melted it, or was it Sevastopol's warm spirit?

1.discuss: You sure you haven't had too much?
reply: Too much? I'm not a baby, Comrade Commander! I can hold my liquor juuuuust fine!

370.text: Spare time is best spent with classical music playing in the background.

1.discuss: Do you want a new record, Lord Bismarck? I can find one for you!
reply: Why, thank you. That would be great.
Don't mention it! I'm always happy to serve!

2.discuss: If you like classical music, you'll love a live orchestra performance.
reply: I'm sure I would. The only issue is making time for it in my busy schedule.

3.discuss: Always a treat to see you in a good mood.
reply: Same to you, my sister. I heard you've come out of your shell and made new friends.
Yes, it's true. Living in such a friendly environment makes it easy, I suppose.

1.discuss: Man, now I want a gramophone in my office.
reply: You won't regret getting one. I can recommend you some records, if you're interested.

1.discuss: you're gonna have to break that bad boy open one day tho
reply: Says who? Once it's full, I'm perfectly content to leave it that way.

2.discuss: You must slay the dragon to receive its treasure, huh? Got it~
reply: Is that a threat? Think about your next words very carefully.
Please, I'm too low level right now! But once I get a ring of invisibility, that dragon's history~
Hmph! I'd like to see you try, you hobbit!

3.discuss: So where does the money for this nest egg of yours come from?
reply: My Regina finds coins here and there around the port. It's not theft if nobody misses it.

1.discuss: It's not much, but it adds up in the end.
reply: Exactly. Set aside a coin here and there, and soon you'll find yourself atop a pile of gold.

372.text: Slow Juustagram day, hmm? Don't mind if I make a post myself!

1.discuss: I swear, it's like you never take your eyes off this app...
reply: You need to keep up with the latest trends to stay on top. Don't you want to know what the Commander is up to?
You're right, I do! I need to check Juustagram more often...
You check it manually? Get with the times and enable push notifications, dummy~
I hate how you're always one step ahead of me...

2.discuss: Did you hear? The ice cream store is bringing back its once-a-season flavor this afternoon only.
reply: I've already reserved a pint! I'm just waiting for time to pass~

1.discuss: See anything cool or funny lately?
reply: Not particularly... Buuut you could totally post a selfie, Commander. You'd be the talk of the town in 5 minutes flat!

373.text: You call this training? Pfft I could do it in my sleep

1.discuss: damn, you were keeping pace with me out there. mad props to you!
reply: Hey, right back at you. You live up to your name of number 1

2.discuss: The course is too dang zigzaggy... Can't we just make it a straight line
reply: It wouldn't be much of a challenge if you could just sail forwards.
I know! Why not add some fun interactive elements?
Ooh, you just gave me inspiration! You know what'd be great? Springboards that send you into the sky!
The training area is for training, not for circus acts, people.

1.discuss: All in all, great performance from everyone!
reply: But mine was the best, right? Come on, you can say it.

1.discuss: cute. you two are like an alligator and a plover
reply: Umm, what does that mean...?
uh it means you're good friends basically. look it up

2.discuss: Nice! You gonna be playing at the banquet? :D
reply: Yup! I hope everyone will like it.

3.discuss: Diligent as ever, I see. Will you be performing for the Commander?
reply: Umm... that's a secret for now!

1.discuss: Can't wait to see the fruits of your practice.
reply: Thank you... We'll both give it our all!

1.discuss: Looking gorgeous! I bet we'd make an awesome duo on stage :3
reply: sure! what do we call ourselves?
How about \"Cat & Rabbit\"? Cause you bring the bunny energy and I bring the cat energy ^w^
it's got a nice ring to it! we're SO doing a duet next time I'm on stage

2.discuss: Quite the impressive performance. For a klutz, anyway.
reply: this was just something I thought I'd try during the rehearsal. the real show will be even better!
If you're that passionate during rehearsals, the real deal might be worth watching.

1.discuss: Attagirl! I love your style.
reply: aww, thanks! you have a great eye for talent, Commander!

376.text: A sleeping Laffey has been spotted in the wild.

1.discuss: Not on the sofa again! I've told her a million times she'll get a cold if she does that!
reply: Well you know her... she falls asleep whenever, wherever ┐(°ヮ°)┌

2.discuss: How is that picture-worthy...
reply: Because it's cute and funny in a way. Did you have a good rest, sleepyhead?
Yeah... Morning...

3.discuss: That has to be the biggest carrot I've ever seen!
reply: It's snug and cozy... Feels like hugging the Commander...
Wait, does it?
Wait what?! I've gotta get one for myself!!

1.discuss: Why is that hat on the cushion?
reply: So I can pretend it's you, I guess?

1.discuss: I've been thinking, haven't you been stuffing yourself quite a bit lately?
reply: What can I say? People have been making irresistibly good food.

2.discuss: I'm pleased to hear you adore my macarons!
reply: Yes, they're delectable. The kind of cooking that makes someone fall for you.
Well... the way to a person's heart is through their stomach, after all.

3.discuss: My lord, how I wisheth that were I...
reply: You want macarons? I can toss you a few when I make my next batch.
Hell yes!

1.discuss: Those must be some top-notch macarons.
reply: That they are. I've never had better.

378.text: I'm working on a song for the Commander.

1.discuss: What's with the handcuffs?
reply: Might serve as a weight so she can train her arm muscles while she plays.
There are better ways to work out than that...
I just thought they might come in handy at some point. Don't overthink it.

2.discuss: Restraining a person using music... Very creative. I like it.
reply: It takes more than music to restrain someone, you know.

1.discuss: I'm in danger, aren't I...
reply: Only in danger of having a good time. You'll love it.

380.text: Where's my letter? WHERE HAS IT GONE?!

1.discuss: Which letter? Surely your declaration of love hasn't gone missing?
reply: Oh dear. Imagine if someone found it and used it to nefarious ends.
Stop imagining doomsday scenarios and help me find it!

2.discuss: Looking for something? My SG radar might be able to help.
reply: Yes please! If you find it return it to me ASAP!!

3.discuss: Snailmail in this day and age? A DM is 5 times quicker and easier.
reply: But a letter is 500 times more romantic!

1.discuss: Want me to look around for you?
reply: Thanks but there's no need to go out of your way for such a small thing!
