1.discuss: As they say, you should drink lots of milk if you want to grow up big!
reply: Is that so? I don't feel like I've grown much at all...
Me either... Not much growth...?

2.discuss: Now that's some fresh-looking milk you got there!
reply: Yes! Homemade and freshly squeezed.
You don't happen to sell it somewhere, do you?
Nope! It's not generally for sale.

1.discuss: I had a taste and yeah, it was pretty good.
reply: Excellent! As your reward, I'll let you drink some more.
Sadly, yes. Come back tomorrow!

2.discuss: Was this your last cup for today?

614.text: Tested the power of my new bomb. Outcome: satisfactory. Tested the efficacy of my new blast-proof glass. Outcome: also satisfactory.

1.discuss: Hey do you have a NEW new bomb that can break through your new blast-proof glass?
reply: hum-hum... then won't you need a new new blast-proof glass to protect against it?
Rejected. We don't have the budget for that.

2.discuss: bombs? i can do bombs! lemme help you!
reply: Then bring your rigging and meet me in the test chamber.

1.discuss: Two birds with one stone. That's efficient testing.
reply: If anything, it's three birds with one stone since you replied. Thank you.
At the moment, the shield is winning. Its desire to protect prevailed, I suppose.

2.discuss: Sounds like a match between the sword and the shield.

1.discuss: Nothing refreshes you quite like a long bath, does it?
reply: That's from Klein Groentje!
Oh really? I'd better go and water it later, then!

2.discuss: Such simple and spontaneous yet beautiful art!
reply: Yes, it's art born from love, heheh.
Well, watch as the Northern Parliament's beloved and talented graffiti master takes this art to the next level!
That's right, the graffiti master in question is ME!

1.discuss: No one can resist drawing on a foggy window.
reply: Our thoughts are one and the same, Commander!
I'd love nothing more than that. Go on, fill this glass with your art!

2.discuss: Now I wanna draw something, too!

616.text: I will imprint my brand upon you!

1.discuss: damn girl those are some sick boots! where'd you get em?
reply: Ah, someone with good taste! I sent you the link!
Wait no! Never mind the boots, pay attention to the brand on the sole!
Never seen that symbol before... Is it from some terrific occult story?
Where it comes from will remain a secret! Forget it... Just look at the boots themselves!

2.discuss: Wow... You look so cool!
reply: Hah! Finally someone who gets it has showed up!

1.discuss: I think I left my stove on, so I'd better go...
reply: Wait, Commander! It won't hurt, I promise! Just give it a try!
Not a fashion brand! Brand as in branding iron! Just come to me and I'll explain it!

2.discuss: You have a fashion brand now? That's unexpected.

617.text: Wahey! First place in the bunny competition!

1.discuss: Wow, congrats! Who got second place?
reply: A bunny.
Nice! I guessed right!

2.discuss: ooh :o i wanna be a bunny too! do i just mimic that pose you're doing?
reply: You've got to mimic a bunny's cry too!
its cry? what kind of sound does a bunny make? \"hippity hoppity\"?
Wan-too wan-too!
oh oki! wan too wan too!
Hmm... Are you certain you didn't pick that up from the radio?

1.discuss: Bunnies get lonely easily, don't they?
reply: Yep, and I'm a lonely bunny right now. Come to me quick and keep me company!
Of course! Come and hippity hop with me!

2.discuss: Are there still spots available in the competition?

618.text: No need to choose if you just drink them all.

1.discuss: Cheers to that! We should have a drinking party!
reply: I can get behind that.
I'd be remiss to pass on such a splendid occasion!
Oh boy, she's back at it again!

2.discuss: Choosing is what children do. Adults get to have it all!
reply: A minor correction, if you don't mind: The underage aren't permitted to drink at all.

1.discuss: There's no way you can drink THAT much.
reply: You can't be sure until you try it, Commander.
Well, if I do get wasted, I'll just sleep it off with you.

2.discuss: Mixing alcohols gets you wasted easily.

619.text: Oh no... How clumsy of me.

1.discuss: How did you even get tangled up in all that yarn?
reply: That's an excellent question! To preface, yarn does not have a smooth surface, but is rather composed of countless little fibers. These fibers create friction between one another, resulting in...
You sure can type a lot for someone who looks pretty tied up (literally)...
So how DID you get tangled up?
Can we change the subject?

2.discuss: Yep. Been there with the cables in my server room.
reply: You can just use a cable organizer.
You reckon you could use one of those to spool the yarn back together?
Yes... It could work!

1.discuss: You okay there? Need help?
reply: Yes, please! Just so you know, however, I will not explain how this happened...
I did... not! Not one little bit, no!

2.discuss: Did you have fun with the yarn balls?

620.text: The training of a model is a most gruelling thing indeed...

1.discuss: Whether it's training to be a maid or a model, you must always be ready for anything.
reply: Yeah!
Also, anyone wanna snap some photos before we do our training thing?

2.discuss: Yooo is this like the hottest fashion trend or what?!
reply: It wouldn't suit you, I can say that. If it's clothing you need, I can tailor some outfits for you.
For realsies? That'd be so sweet!

3.discuss: Ooh, all these clothes smell like... danger
reply: What mean you by that?
Oh yes, dangerous with a capital D!

1.discuss: I can help you with that.
reply: Your accompaniment would surely make light work of even the strictest training.
Grateful am I for your concern, Commander. May I ask of you to join me on one of these breaks?

2.discuss: Just don't overdo it and be sure to take breaks.

621.text: This should be a fitting depiction of longing...

1.discuss: Wow, that's a really realistic statue! Did Raffaello make it?
reply: Such melancholic listlessness... Its existence is a miracle!
So true to life yet so emotionally stirring... and no that's not my style

2.discuss: The pain of waiting. I know it well.
reply: It makes a single day feel like an eternity...
You might shut your eyes for just a moment, and the day's gone just like that...

1.discuss: Is that really a mere statue?
reply: If it is the answer you seek, then come and find out.
The receival of your reply brings much relief to my heart.

2.discuss: Don't worry. I'll be right there.

622.text: Just a little more... then I will have completed my 24-hour nonstop pirouette challenge!

1.discuss: Like a record, baby, right 'round, 'round, 'round...
reply: The text is spinning and I'm getting dizzy...
By my count, we're currently at 104,567 rotations.

2.discuss: Neato! I think I wanna give it a shot as well.
reply: Hello? You there?
She just passed out.

1.discuss: Speeeeeen!
reply: Although I did faint, the motivation to continue hit me like thunder the instant that I received your message, Commander! Here we go!
Thank goodness...

2.discuss: Good job, you beat the challenge!

623.text: Oh no, these documents have been damaged... Deep breaths, little ones. I'll patch you up.

1.discuss: If you need a hand with that, please don't be afraid to call for me.
reply: Thank you for the offer, Janus.

2.discuss: Those poor little things... How did they get damaged?
reply: Gather round the campfire, because once upon a time...
An hour ago, we went on an adventure to the basement and rescued these documents!
They'd been squashed under a table leg and were in a critical state!
Only the cover was kinda readable. I think it said it was a \"collection of the port's spiciest gossip\"?
BIG if true! Let me know as soon as they're in better shape!

1.discuss: Have they recovered from their... wounds?
reply: Yes! I'll give you a brief on their condition later.
Of course. I think you're in more urgent need of a check-up, though. I'll be there in a minute.

2.discuss: Could you check out the papers I filed last night?

624.text: That was a long photoshoot... Need food.

1.discuss: Wow that looks yummy! Makes me wanna do a foodie episode!
reply: I know several good burger joints if you'd like recommendations.
Perfect! Let me go get my camera!
Take me along.

2.discuss: Yes, I should replenish my energy as well. Fortunately, I still have some soda left in my studio.
reply: And I bought one burger too many, so how about we...
Do a little trade?
Yeah.

1.discuss: That's one tasty-looking burger.
reply: I can share it... if you're okay with at most half.
Yeah. Want a taste?

2.discuss: Was the drink any good?

625.text: Jade vase, jade pillow, jade folding screen... All practical items, but I'm sadly short on coin right now...

1.discuss: Anchorage drew a picture of the things you want!
reply: You can have it heheh
Thank you. I got it. It's a very heartwarming picture.

2.discuss: I drew some stuff too!
reply: Thanks, Svirepy. I got yours too. It's... how do I put it? Very artistic!

3.discuss: Why not set out on a journey? Try to channel your yearning for jade into a longing for travel.
reply: Ridding oneself of one's worldly desires and building character through a journey... Yes, this makes for good training.
You make a convincing case. I'll embark now.
Um... Would any kind soul be willing to provide me with some funds for my journey home? I spent the last of my traveling budget on jades...

1.discuss: I'm always here for you if you've got any issues.
reply: You always come to my aid when I need it... Your kindness is more precious than any jade on this earth.
That remains to be seen. For now, though, I can offer you my lap as a pillow.

2.discuss: Would a jade pillow really feel... comfortable?

626.text: I'm using a shower gel that I myself developed. I think its unique scent will be to everyone's liking.

1.discuss: Ah, so it was you who came up with that fragrance.
reply: I've tried it. It smells like nature and it's wonderful.
I adore it for how much it smells like milk.
I'm a sucker for that fried chicken smell it's got!
That's... a lot of different ways to interpret the same scent.

2.discuss: Ah yes! Managing your body odor is hugely important!
reply: Do you often use perfume, Mogador? We could perhaps exchange formulas.
Sorry, but my formula is a secret for now! Heheh...

1.discuss: I feel like I can smell it from here.
reply: What a keen sense of smell you have. I just arrived outside your door, in fact.
Is it the gel you seek, or is it really my scent? Heheh.

2.discuss: I'd love some of that gel, too.

627.text: Yesternight, this one dreamt of drifting aboard a boat... before plunging into a moonlit sea of flowers...

1.discuss: That sounds like a wonderful dream!
reply: How I envy you... My dream was riddled with popups, and even the music was replaced with warning sounds.
Mine was just okay. I dreamed I worked overtime and got the whole week's worth of work done!
you girls don't have quite pure reasons for sleeping do you

2.discuss: A moonlit sea of flowers... Sounds like you went to the legendary Faraway Arcadia!
reply: What is that? Its name carries a mystical sound...
They say it's the boundary between dreams and reality, and red spider lilies bloom there as far as the eye can see!
That rings a bell... In fact, I know where that garden is! You can get there in 10 minutes on foot.
Seriously?! That's a lot closer than I thought! We should check it out tonight!

1.discuss: Let's go have some breakfast together.
reply: This one shall attend to her attire first, then come to you...
Then this one shall return to the land of dreams... Prithee, won't you join me?

2.discuss: You're up pretty early. Why not sleep a little longer?

628.text: Just in case the syrup splatters...

1.discuss: Keep going! Remember: you have to make enough candied strawberries to feed the whole port!
reply: That's impossible! Besides, SOME people must not want one because their teeth hurt!

2.discuss: I think that's a safe distance...
reply: But the chopsticks are so heavy... My arm hurts! ;-;
Why not let a drone do it? I'll lend you one.
Thanks! I'll give it a shot!
Nooo! The propellers got coated with syrup... It fell out of the air!

1.discuss: Safety first. Also, there are longer chopsticks, if you need them.
reply: You're a lifesaver! Please come help me with this!
I'll give you an extra large portion if you come and help! Please?!

2.discuss: Man, that looks so tasty.

629.text: Be sure to look under your pillows when you awake, children.

1.discuss: Thanksies! I got a red envelope!
reply: Thank you so much! But... how did the envelope get there?
That reminds me of a similar mystery. Why do Christmas presents always appear in my stockings?
looked it up and apparently its ~*~magic~*~
Quite true! It's magic!

2.discuss: So I get a red envelope just for going to bed and waking up?! I'm gonna do that 10 times today then!
reply: 1st time
2nd
3rd
4th
10th time! I've woken up 10 times!
So why did I only get a single envelope?!
If you close your eyes, Lady Yuen's red envelope will duplicate!
It doesn't count if you take turns sleeping with your eyes open, you two.

1.discuss: There was an envelope under mine, and it felt unusually thick.
reply: That's the one I made especially for you, my child. I hope you like it.
That's a good child.

2.discuss: Thanks, mommy!

630.text: Bol'shaya pobeda! That means great victory!

1.discuss: We've made warming borscht! Come over and have a bowl!
reply: I helped make it. I'm not saying it tastes odd, but if it does, it's just your imagination.
I know this flavor... Did you add vodka into the mix?
That was some borscht! It warmed me right up.

2.discuss: The best proof that you've trained a lot is when your muscles shine in the light!
reply: Right you are!

1.discuss: What amazing skiing! Well done, champion!
reply: Thanks for the acknowledgement, my friend.
Of course, my best of friends.

2.discuss: You should tutor me sometime, champion!

1.discuss: Outstanding work! You set an ideal example for others!
reply: Truly. Your data is solid and your conclusions are logical.
That's the student we all worked to cultivate! Be sure to share your thoughts with us after school!
Will do! Thank you, my teachers! I'll strive to do even better!

2.discuss: You've already finished all of today's homework, haven't you? Wow, if only I could be as smart as you!
reply: Can we borrow yours and compare ours to it? We just need it for a minute!
I'm NOT going to let you lazily copy mine! Come to my place NOW for extra lessons!
She's onto us! Bail out!

1.discuss: A well-deserved first place.
reply: Hah! It's only natural.
Well, since you insist... I'll be coming to supervise your work later.

2.discuss: Now why not lay off the studying and relax for a bit?

632.text: Oh yes... I'm going to get hooked on this.

1.discuss: Krasny... can also emit sparks?
reply: What you consider \"sparks\" is probably not the same as this...

2.discuss: Static electricity... My enemy.
reply: Mine also!
Yeah, same.

1.discuss: It's a... unique kind of pleasure.
reply: I figured you'd think so! We should enjoy it together!
Do you want to try something more... stimulating? Heheh...

2.discuss: That's one way to interpret it, I suppose.

1.discuss: Looks perfect...
reply: For taking...
A nap...
Excuse me?

2.discuss: This allows for rapid response to Master's commands.
reply: Status synchronization complete. Ready for orders at any moment.
Likewise, this one is now at peak responsiveness!
Great. This way we can more efficiently support the Commander.

1.discuss: Did you have a good nap?
reply: Sleep quality: Good. I dreamed about you, Commander.
Good. I can't wait to do more joint work with you.

2.discuss: I always appreciate your help.

634.text: I can't believe I got caught~♪

1.discuss: Where exactly are you trying to \"infiltrate\" anyway?
reply: Umm... definitely not the Commander's room or anything!
Reaaally? #doubt
#doubt
You definitely are not beating the allegations.

2.discuss: Such advanced ninjutsu techniques... Unryuu, please teach me your ways!
reply: I wanna learn too!
Huh? You want to learn from little ol' me?

1.discuss: Am I imagining it, or do I hear the sound of leaking water?
reply: It's not your imagination, Commander. I'm right next to you~♪
Not sure that's possible, buuut... we can start by disappearing somewhere first, just the two of us~♪

2.discuss: The art of invisibility? I'd love to learn that one for myself.

1.discuss: Hang in there! This one is like SSS-tier difficulty among all escape magicks!
reply: That's right! Even I would struggle with an array of lasers this dense!
Help... I'm doooomed...

2.discuss: Fear not! My Super Laser Changing Device only melts away your clothing and rigging, not affecting your body at all!
reply: Why would you invent something so bizarre?!
For the sake of efficiency, of course! What's better than being able to take off all your clothes without lifting a finger?
Huh. That does sound pretty handy. Can you make me one as well?
What's wrong with you?

1.discuss: I'll go turn the lasers off.
reply: ...That's all? Not even interested in sneaking a peek?!
Thanks, but, umm... could you maybe give me a hand with that?

2.discuss: I've got a change of clothes for you.

1.discuss: It's almost time for the fated battle, huh?
reply: Stay hidden in the shadows, and wait for an opportunity to launch a counterattack against a defenseless foe!
We'll break our way out of the siege, take down the mastermind, and rescue the Commander!
Yeah. That's an awesome plot. I really like it.
Mhm, I like the sound of that. Let's go with that!

2.discuss: Oh... Another way of using your tail?
reply: Miss Dragon God, please be careful with that. It's not safe...

1.discuss: My phone's about to run out of juice...
reply: Leave it to me! My tail is ready to handle this!
Heehee, let's take care of this trouble together.

2.discuss: Get ready to break through on my count!

637.text: This data goes beyond my wildest expectations.

1.discuss: Do you need help? I'm happy to provide support at any time.
reply: Would you please? There are still so many things I don't understand...
Sounds like fun! Let me join in!
Count me in too!
Hehe. I look forward to working with all of you.

2.discuss: I bet fighting with that thing would be a hell of a time!
reply: Well said! We must do all within our power to seize that which would make us stronger!
Hehehe... I can already imagine it dancing gracefully amidst a blood-soaked battlefield.
What active imaginations you all have...

1.discuss: If it impressed you, then we must have knocked it out of the park this time.
reply: You can say that again. Would you like to take a look with me?
Hehe, I'll finish testing and analysis as swiftly as I can.

2.discuss: Sure. I'll need to devise tactics that take advantage of this new firepower, after all.

638.text: Wow, so many costumes and props...

1.discuss: Hey, a fellow cosplayer! Want to try some costumes on with me?
reply: I've got costumes and props here that you won't find at Akashi's shop.
O-okay. I accept...

2.discuss: If they don't have what you want... I could make it for you...
reply: I would be happy to assist with any sewing. Just leave it to me!
I can be on hand to help with any technical issues.
Thank you everyone! I don't know what to say...

1.discuss: Did you see any costumes you liked?
reply: Yes. A lovely one, and it was so fluffy.
Maybe that ninja one... It was so cool... Kon♪

2.discuss: What about one you really wanted to wear?

639.text: If anybody has stories to tell, I'll mix a special drink just for you.

1.discuss: Heheh, now this looks like a place where I can try some unique drinks.
reply: Hm? Would those stories happen to be about my Contract Binder?
If you want to hear, then why don't you come join us?
My, my. What fascinating things you seem to be discussing.

2.discuss: What pretty colors... That must taste delicious!
reply: They're just as colorful as juice! I want to try some, too!
Don't drink too much, girls.
Don't worry. I'll prepare a non-alcoholic blend just for them.

1.discuss: One drink per story?
reply: Hehe, that depends on whether your stories are worth making such an exception for.
Ordinary, uneventful days can be just as flavorful as any other.

2.discuss: What drink would I get if my story was \"nothing really happened today\"?

640.text: So many incredible things have happened at this port...

1.discuss: Hehe, I've got even spicier info than that!
reply: I have lots of secret intel, too! Nyahaha~
You mean it?! Please... PLEASE, I have to know more!
So are we just letting this happen now? Nobody's gonna stop this?

2.discuss: I have really good books too ^.^
reply: Anchorage knows lots of stories too!
If you want to hear anecdotes about the port, I might have a few to share.
Ooh! At this rate, I'll never run out of story ideas!
I'm willing to bet those anecdotes are more than a little bit embellished...
It's the space between fact and fiction that makes stories truly captivating, after all~

1.discuss: That's a lot of story ideas. Have you thought of a protagonist yet?
reply: Not yet... but I stashed every flash of inspiration in my notebook!
I really am! Every day is full of new discoveries and inspo!

2.discuss: I'm happy that you're having a good time.

641.text: Oh, that's weird... Why does my radio always act up around here?

1.discuss: Must be faulty wiring. Want me to take a look inside for you?
reply: WHOA! I've GOT to see what that thing looks like inside!
No, you can't! This is my most precious treasure!
TRUST ME! I'm so smart, I could put it back together even IF I blew it up!

2.discuss: I know! Maybe that area is home to unexplained phenomena that mess with radio waves?!
reply: OR, maybe, the signal is just weak around there.
Oh... I think I know this! It's like how my heartbeat goes haywire when I'm near the Commander...
Data collection and analysis completed. It's probable that signals are restricted in that area.
Wow, really... Okay, then I'll just go hang out somewhere else!

1.discuss: That's suspicious. Want me to come look for the cause?
reply: Investigating with you sounds fun. Let's do it!
Yeah! This place has all sorts of interesting programs I've never heard of before!

2.discuss: If you're that preoccupied with it, I'm guessing you must have been listening to a really interesting program.

642.text: I came out to the port to take some selfies, and who do I bump into but a fellow shutterbug?! Yay♪

1.discuss: Photography is one of the fundamentals of journalism! I can't let a single photo opportunity pass me by!
reply: Right?! And passion is the secret ingredient that lets you capture those moments!
Yep! You said it!

2.discuss: That's a great shot! You sure got a knack for this, Yukino!
reply: Heh, how about painting your nails red? They'd look even more perfect on camera.
Oh my gosh, that's a great idea! I've got some red polish, so I'll give it a try for the next one.
We seem to have much in common, Yukino. I would like it if you could join our next gathering.
You mean it?! Yippee! Count me in!

1.discuss: Looks like you've got more friends to take pictures with.
reply: Yep! There's nothing like having buddies to share your hobbies with! Yay♪
Hehehe! I'm gonna take the best photo ever, and you'll be the first to see it♪

2.discuss: I'll look forward to your next group shot.

643.text: This plane's going too slow... I'm going on ahead!

1.discuss: I think...
reply: You might...
Go even faster? Hell yeah!

2.discuss: Too fast! Keep to the speed limit!
reply: Hm? Does the port have speed limits?
...Does it not?
Of course it doesn't!

1.discuss: Will you be back for dinner?
reply: Yeah! I'm eating with you, Commander!
Burn and send 'em flying!

2.discuss: Thunderheart!

1.discuss: Whoa, how'd you do that? That's amazing!
reply: I want to try too!
That's nothing hard at all! Watch me blow a pizza-shaped soap bubble!
so? how did it go
She just choked on the soap bubble... We need to get her thoroughly checked.

2.discuss: This is so convenient! Now we can talk to each other even underwater!
reply: You can even tell what she's thinking...
You could probably use the communicator to do the same thing...
That's totally different! This is much cooler!

1.discuss: That's a great smile!
reply: The commander replied... I'm so happy o(*//▿//*)q
Okay♪ I will show you how it's done in person (o°▿°)o

2.discuss: Please teach me how to do it, Miss U-2501!

646.text: I brought a gift. Would you please let me in?

1.discuss: How polite and proper~
reply: One may never enter a house unless invited by its owner, after all~
This is common knowledge in my family.
Ohh, I see~ Sounds like you guys are all well-mannered~

2.discuss: If I may, I don't think you are meant to enter or exit through a window.
reply: I thought this would feel a little more ceremonious.
I totally get it! Being able to just go through the window is what makes flying soenjoyable!

1.discuss: Maybe try the doorbell next time?
reply: Oh, that's hardly necessary. Once I'm allowed in once, I can come and go as I please♪
You're very welcome. That said, I have something I'm certain you'll find much more delicious. Would you like a try?

2.discuss: Thanks for the fruit basket. That was really good.

647.text: Check this out~ It's a magic lamp with an unlimited supply of water♪

1.discuss: That's strange... The story that I heard is that your wish will come true if you drink the lamp's water...
reply: Making wishes upon lamps? That's an outdated version and behind the times.
Do ghost stories really change so frequently...?
Well, I came up with a new idea and all♪

2.discuss: This could be used to water plants~
reply: This all feels so strange for some reason...
Lamps are for lighting... Why is there water coming out of a lamp?
It's about subverting expectations~ This is a magic lamp precisely because there's water coming out of it.

3.discuss: If you're done with the hose, can I come take it back?
reply: Wait, just a little longer! This isn't all that the magic lamp is capable of♪

1.discuss: Feels like the kind of puddle that would grant buffs...
reply: Want to know if it actually does that? Come try it out for yourself, Commander♪
Exactly~ Isn't that totally magical?

2.discuss: So its magic powers come from a hose, huh?

648.text: I fumbled my way into a seagull party and now I can't leave...

1.discuss: Looks like they REALLY like fries.
reply: So many fries! I need to join... restore peace and order to the beach!

2.discuss: There's a fries party going on? Where? I wanna go! I'll come to the party and protect you from the seagulls!
reply: At the pier...
Fries at the pier!
Fries at the pier!

1.discuss: That's a lot of fries...
reply: I thought I could share some with you, Commander, so...
Thanks, Commander! You can take my share!

2.discuss: I'll have the some that are still fine.

649.text: Why haven't I made it back to shore yet...?

1.discuss: Looks like the waves are strong enough to push your water ball back toward the sea. Perhaps you haven't been making any progress toward the shore at all.
reply: You gotta put in more oomph! Move your legs faster and beat the waves! Trust in your own potential!

2.discuss: Don't fret. I'll teach you all you need to know for survival at sea.
reply: You'd do well to study the \"Desert Island Survival Guide\" and \"Shelter Construction Manual\" now. I'll send them to you.
Here's another that will really come in handy: \"How to Kill Time.\"

3.discuss: what a coincidence, i just fell into the sea myself! where are you right now? let's team up!
reply: I don't know where I am... I can see nothing but the open sea around me...
me too! sounds like we're real close to each other. i bet we'll find each other right away!

1.discuss: I will come help you, so stay right where you are.
reply: Thanks, Commander! I'll be waiting for you on the sea~
Nothing's wrong with the water ball yet... I'm having a little trouble with the path I'm taking, though...

2.discuss: Is there something wrong with your transportation again...?

1.discuss: What's with the bucket though?
reply: As long as you've got a bucket of water...
No matter how high you fall from...
You can land without taking damage♪
What?? Is this a reference I'm not getting?

2.discuss: Hey, you really ought to put some more clothes on!
reply: But it's nice and cool this way...
Such imprudence is a sin.
Oooh? Are you gonna fly here and give your judgment, dear angel?
Joffre seriously just took flight!

1.discuss: I won't lose that easily.

Heehee, thank you both in advance.

My internal temperature skyrockets when I'm with the Commander, so the water should evaporate!

654.text: It's the moment we've been waiting for, Commander.

1.discuss: Nice ride. I might get one for myself!

Heheh, our team put our blood, sweat, and tears into this baby!

My data is insufficient, but it may be worth a try.

1.discuss: So this is the Unhulde's new ride...
reply: Nice, isn't it? I had it customized for your enjoyment specifically.
I've planned a surprise. You'll find out soon enough...

2.discuss: Where are we going?

655.text: Should I wear black stockings, or white? Who knows...

1.discuss: Never mind, black wins! White could never~
reply: Is that so?
Obviously.

\"What could be wrong about that?\" What could be right about that?

Utter nonsense! I know better than anyone what the Commander prefers!
Why don't we just ask directly, then?
Sounds perfect to me!

1.discuss: Which one did you end up choosing?
reply: I decided on neither~
Shush! If people realized they could wear both at the same time, this thread wouldn't get any traction!

2.discuss: Is there no third option?

1.discuss: Are you... breaking obstacles?
reply: Nope. Home renovations!

2.discuss: Thanks for your help! The renovation work is finally back on schedule.
reply: Don't sweat it. I definitely didn't~

3.discuss: Thank you for your hard work, renovation crew. I look forward to the before-and-after comparison.
reply: Um, wasn't your renovation scheduled for next week?
Hey! I was next in line!
Pssh, you girls are so particular about order.
I just checked, and it is Chao Ho's turn today.
Busted...

reply: There was no nameplate on the door... Wait, was this part of Ying Swei's plan, too?!

2.discuss: Did you mix up the order?

Yuudachi has just devoured ten plates in the blink of an eye! They're neck and neck!

There's no need to beat around the bush to begin with, as long as you have enough passion... Hehehe...
Um... I think this conversation has gone way off the rails compared to A2's original point...

reply: That might work... but it also feels like you'd also be sacrificing something important...

659.text: So many new pieces of equipment that I've never seen before... I wonder how potent they are.

...Does that mean it'll explode in a perfectly safe manner?

It's because I finished the weeding, and preparing the afternoon tea was my next task after that.

Against.

Heehee, good move. By the way, is anybody else on that list?

reply: According to the hazardous-item list, your snacks are classified as highly dangerous.
Once I confiscate them, you may enter.
You've really saved us all today, Hostile.
Clap clap clap~
